0ac1b2d47dede778.name: d20_test

finding_target.description: Actual creature this Wisdom Perception or Survival check attempts to find.

0ac1b2d47dede778.description: Resolve an SRD 5.2.1 skill check for a campaign character. Choose the participant, skill, target number, circumstantial modifier, sensory requirements, and applicable advantage or disadvantage. Sylvia derives the entity state, ability, and proficiency from authority. Call this only when success or failure is genuinely uncertain and matters to play. Routine description of immediately obvious surroundings needs no check; a general look around is not by itself a Perception check. Use Perception when detecting something concealed or otherwise uncertain would produce a meaningful different outcome. Never substitute this skill check for a weapon attack, spell attack, or other mechanic with its own exposed operation. Use ability_check for a check without a skill, with a tool, or with a situationally appropriate different ability.

armor_class.description: AC from the source or explicit GM adjudication.

cantrip_scaling_level.description: Default 1. Supply another level only when the stat block explicitly grants scaled cantrips; never substitute Challenge Rating.

challenge_rating_eighths.description: The stat block's Challenge Rating multiplied by eight. Omit when unknown; transformation eligibility then cannot be asserted from this creature state.

charisma_save.description: Optional signed charisma saving-throw modifier. Supply the source value or explicitly adjudicate it; omission does not establish a zero modifier.

constitution_save.description: Optional signed constitution saving-throw modifier. Supply the source value or explicitly adjudicate it; omission does not establish a zero modifier.

creature_id.description: Stable unique ID for this individual creature, at most 128 letters/digits or . _ : -. Reuse it later; never use a Player Character or Companion ID.

creature_type.description: Creature type from the selected stat block. Omit when unknown; type-qualified spell effects cannot infer it.

damage_immunities.description: Copy all damage immunities from the source; an omitted list means none.

damage_resistances.description: Copy all damage resistances from the source; an omitted list means none.

damage_vulnerabilities.description: Copy all damage vulnerabilities from the source; an omitted list means none.

dexterity_save.description: Optional signed dexterity saving-throw modifier. Supply the source value or explicitly adjudicate it; omission does not establish a zero modifier.

equipment.description: Optional one equipment profile from the stat block or recorded GM adaptation. Record base speeds before armor, AC without worn gear (including natural defenses), Strength/Dexterity, armor training, and zero or one carried item in armor/shield. Supplied final AC and walking Speed must agree. Omit only when gear changes are not needed.

flying_speed.description: Copy actual native Flying Speed from the source; zero if none.

hit_points.description: Current and maximum HP for this newly introduced, unwounded creature. Never prepare an existing wounded creature again.

initiative_modifier.description: Signed Initiative modifier from the source or explicit GM adjudication.

intelligence_save.description: Optional signed intelligence saving-throw modifier. Supply the source value or explicitly adjudicate it; omission does not establish a zero modifier.

multiattack.description: Optional pure-attack Multiattack routine from the read stat block or explicit recorded adaptation. Each attack name is unique, at most 120 characters, and names one component with its permitted count. This does not encode spell substitutions or other non-attack effects.

proficiency_bonus.description: Actual stat-block Proficiency Bonus when a spell-created creature inherits it.

saving_throw_proficiencies.description: Copy the explicit complete proficiency list from the source. Omission leaves training unknown; an empty list explicitly records none.

size_rank.description: Size from the source or recorded adjudication: Tiny 0, Small 1, Medium 2, Large 3, Huge 4, Gargantuan 5.

skill_checks.description: Actual total NPC skill-check modifiers from the selected stat block. For an unlisted skill use its actual ability modifier. Omitted skills remain unknown; never guess them from saving throws.

skill_proficiencies.description: Copy the explicit complete proficiency list from the source. Omission leaves training unknown; an empty list explicitly records none.

source.description: 1 to 1000 characters: identify the read Plan/Setting/stat-block reference and explicitly explain any GM-adjudicated adaptation or missing statistics.

speed.description: Walking speed in feet from the source or explicit GM adjudication.

spell_component_exemptions.description: Copy only components explicitly waived by this creature stat block. Empty means normal spell components are required; do not infer a waiver from slot-free casting.

spells.description: Executable spells from the stat block. Each has its own X/day pool; 0 means at will. Omit casting_level for its lowest level. Set it only for an explicit stat-block exception; shared pools and other restrictions are not encoded by this list.

strength_save.description: Optional signed strength saving-throw modifier. Supply the source value or explicitly adjudicate it; omission does not establish a zero modifier.

wisdom_save.description: Optional signed wisdom saving-throw modifier. Supply the source value or explicitly adjudicate it; omission does not establish a zero modifier.

0714d7e302704846.name: start_combat_encounter_entities

first_surprised.description: True only when the first creature was unaware that combat was starting. Use false for a creature that declares the attack or is already watching, threatening, or ready to act.

second_surprised.description: True only when the second creature was unaware that combat was starting. Use false for a creature that is already watching, threatening, or ready to act.

uncanny_metabolism_users.description: Monk combatants choosing Uncanny Metabolism when Initiative is rolled: regain all Focus and heal Monk level plus the Martial Arts die, once per Long Rest. Leave empty to decline; eligible level-15 Monks then receive Perfect Focus automatically.

0714d7e302704846.description:
Roll Initiative and establish an encounter between two canonical creature states. When combat is inactive and the player declares a hostile weapon attack against a known present creature, including a companion, you MUST call this operation before any player-facing prose and before resolving the attack, then follow the freshly exposed combat lifecycle and weapon-attack operations. Do not decide in prose that the attack misses, is deflected, or is de-escalated. Do not restate the scene or ask what the player does instead. Do not substitute an Athletics or other skill check for the attack.
Coordinate combat requires a saved spatial scene. For the first encounter, supply one scene in combat_scenes using the spatial_scene format 1 content definition: format=1; map with id, revision, bounds.min/max (three coordinates), grid.cell_size/unit='ft'/origin (two coordinates), and layers (id/min_elevation/max_elevation); entities, geometry, zones and terrain arrays. Each combatant needs exactly one active creature body: id, map_id, position (three coordinates), footprint (box.half_extents or circle.radius), height, facing (two coordinates), active, movement, visibility, and metadata with participant_ref equal to its saved actor ID, creature_type, plane and lighting. Choose physical positions and body dimensions from the encounter fiction; do not invent a target-distance substitute. Include known blockers and terrain. Declare metadata.player.label/kind only on bodies and geometry the player knows. 
Coordinate combat uses the saved spatial scene. Supply one combat_scenes entry when admitting a later roster or an actual new arena. Omit it to reuse the scene. For the same map ID, keep the existing bounds, grid and layers: all saved bodies, objects, blockers, zones and terrain remain authoritative; supplied rows with existing IDs do not edit or relocate them. New IDs add genuinely present scene facts. For a new map ID, explicitly place every accompanying saved body/object by its exact ID. Existing dimensions, activity and mechanic metadata are retained; only actual destination position, facing, plane and ambient lighting are admitted. Include active summons, carried/worn objects, and a live Mage Hand with its cargo and caster. Arena replacement is unavailable while an anchored object, wall panel including permanent Stone, retained coordinate area/terrain or anchored light needs its current scene. Those effects are preserved and the operation clearly rejects before initiative; do not remove them or substitute a different map ID to bypass this limit. Exploration does not require map movement.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: ability_check

finding_target.description: Actual creature this Wisdom Perception or Survival check attempts to find.

interaction_target.description: Creature this Charisma check socially interacts with; saved Charm Advantage is derived automatically.

cfd8765f49d42832.description: Resolve an identified character's ability check without a skill, using a tool, or using a different ability with a skill when the situation warrants it. Name one of the six abilities and any applicable skill/tool. The engine derives ability and ordinary proficiency modifiers from the saved character. Relevant skill and tool proficiency together grant Advantage, never a second proficiency bonus. Use only for uncertain outcomes that matter. Use dedicated Hide, Search, Study, Influence or combat operations when their rules apply. This operation does not infer class features such as Expertise; adjudicate their documented effects explicitly.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: activate_srd_weapon_set
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Switch a prepared weapon set freely on this creature's own turn. Switching never restores an Action, attack, Light/Nick use or other resource.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: admit_srd_native_wight_rise_language
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Admit the future Zombie's printed other understood language, not rise eligibility.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: advance_srd_lasting_time
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Advance the bounded package-owned lasting-effect clock outside an encounter.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: advance_stable_recovery
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Advance the official 1d4-hour recovery clock for a Stable creature at 0 Hit Points.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: ask_srd_divination_question
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Ask within the source-owned question count and actual one-minute interval; the GM supplies the source-authorized answer.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: attack_srd_altered_natural_weapon
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Attack with the active Alter Self growth using saved proficiency and caster modifier.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: attack_srd_transformed_form
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Use one actual named Beast-form attack and its source-owned numbers and anatomy.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: award_srd_advancement

award_id.description: Stable milestone ID, or unique XP event ID.

character_state.description: The same character ID, selecting its live mechanical state.

evidence.description: Played event satisfying the policy, including allocation.

xp.description: Allocated XP for this character; 0 for milestones.

cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record a Plan milestone or allocated XP award once for this character. Read the policy and verify its trigger, timing and recipients first. Repeat for every eligible party member when the policy awards the whole party. An award does not apply a level or resolve player choices.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: begin_srd_after_hit_smite
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Reserve an after-hit spell Bonus Action on this saved final weapon hit.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: begin_srd_character_attack

attack_ability.description: Match the selected weapon. A dart uses Dexterity and a quarterstaff uses Strength. Other finesse weapons permit either, ordinary melee or thrown weapons use Strength, and ordinary ranged weapons use Dexterity.

attack_mode.description: Match the selected weapon's legal use. A dart uses thrown, never melee; a quarterstaff uses melee. Use ranged only for a ranged weapon that is not being thrown.

other_wielded_weapons.description: Actual other weapon IDs wielded alongside the selected weapon, not everything carried. Supply every other held weapon; empty means none.

use_stunning_strike.description: Spend one Focus Point on a hit for Monk level 5 Stunning Strike, at most once this combat turn.

weapon.description: Omit for the clear active main-hand weapon. An explicit weapon must belong to the active prepared set. Ask the player to select an unresolved set rather than substitute another carried weapon.

wielding_two_handed.description: Saved equipped weapons determine actual hands; this legacy input cannot override an active prepared set.

cfd8765f49d42832.description: Reserve the attack cost, resolve targeting, then retain its real roll for reactions.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: begin_srd_controlled_steed_phase
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Let the controlled Otherworldly Steed act on its actual riding caster's turn. Use Dash, Disengage or Dodge for its Action; its own Bonus Action stays separate. Pause this phase to resume the rider, then re-enter without refreshing spent budgets.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: begin_srd_creature_attack

attack_distance.description: Actual distance to this target in feet.

attack_modifier.description: Signed d20 attack modifier from the admitted creature stat block or GM adaptation.

attack_name.description: Plain attack label from the admitted creature stat block or the GM's stated adaptation.

damage_expression.description: Damage dice only; select one exact enum value and do not include a modifier.

damage_modifier.description: Signed flat damage modifier applied after the damage dice.

long_range.description: Maximum ranged distance; for melee use the same value as normal_range.

normal_range.description: Melee reach or normal ranged distance in feet from the stat block or stated adaptation.

target.description: Exact authoritative entity ID of the living attack target; do not use its display name.

use_multiattack.description: Use a remaining named component of the creature's prepared Multiattack; true on every attack in that routine.

cfd8765f49d42832.description: Reserve the attack cost, resolve targeting, then retain its real roll for reactions.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: begin_srd_extended_spell_action
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Perform this longer casting or Ritual action, then leave its actual Counterspell window open. Complete the saved window before further casting progress.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: begin_srd_otherworldly_forced_movement
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Begin a declared involuntary movement of the actual mounted Otherworldly Steed. The DC 10 rider Dexterity save must resolve before motion; this spends no voluntary movement.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: begin_srd_rest
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Start a tracked Short or Long Rest at the current campaign time. Long Rests need eight hours including six hours asleep and at most two of light activity; after finishing one, wait sixteen hours before starting another. Use set_srd_rest_activity to change activity, resume interruptions or abandon it, and advance_srd_lasting_time once for elapsed time shared by the party.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: begin_srd_scene_fall
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Open a Feather Fall Reaction window for actual airborne scene creatures.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: begin_srd_spell_cast
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Begin a source-defined longer casting or Ritual. Continue its Magic action each combat turn, or account for uninterrupted exploration rounds; then finish using cast_spell with current target facts. A failed Slow gesture spends the casting costs immediately.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: cast_srd_reaction_spell
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Cast a prepared Reaction spell against an actual saved trigger.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: change_srd_character_shield
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Equip or remove a carried shield through the existing armor authority and its ordinary combat cost.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: change_srd_equipment
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Don or doff one carried armor or shield. Empty item removes the worn item; one item equips it. Remove an existing item before replacing it. Use established item type and magic bonus, never invent equipment. Armor uses its SRD don/doff minutes outside combat; a shield uses a Utilize action in combat or one round outside combat.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: change_srd_transformation
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Spend one Magic action to change the original eligible form or selected Animal Shapes subjects.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: check_srd_native_wight_ability
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Resolve this actual Wight's native ability check from saved source statistics.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: choose_srd_chromatic_orb_leap

target_distance.description: Current target distance in feet when not supplied by saved combat geometry. Supply the established scene distance; self-targeting is distance zero.

cfd8765f49d42832.description: Choose or decline Chromatic Orb's earned leap in its original paid casting.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: collect_srd_irresistible_dance
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Spend a real action and repeat the active Dance source's Wisdom save to collect yourself.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: command_srd_summoned_creature
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Give an active summoned creature a verbal command without spending the caster's action.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: communicate_srd_spell
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Consume spell-enabled communication and source-bounded information eligibility.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: complete_srd_pending_action
cfd8765f49d42832.description:
Complete the saved action after its reaction window without another roll or cost.
Outside combat, when this spell heals a caster with an active Otherworldly Steed, first call establish_srd_lite_steed_healing_proximity with that exact caster and Steed, their current established nearest separation in feet, and whether they currently share a plane. This fact authorizes one healing qualification at the current lasting tick; establish it immediately before the healing event. Birth placement is never current proximity. Combat Life Bond always measures the admitted actual bodies.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: complete_srd_rest
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Complete a tracked rest after the clock and activity requirements are met. Restore encoded class resources or NPC per-day spells; a Long Rest also restores HP and Hit Dice, removes ordinary Temporary HP and reduces recoverable Exhaustion. Short Rest Hit Dice remain a separate player choice. Missing resource maxima are never invented.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: continue_srd_extended_spell_action

somatic_component_available.description: Defaults to true. Held weapons, shields and other items never prevent spell gestures, in or out of combat. Set false only when the scene prevents the caster from moving enough to gesture.

cfd8765f49d42832.description: Perform this longer casting or Ritual action, then leave its actual Counterspell window open. Complete the saved window before further casting progress.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: continue_srd_spell_cast

somatic_component_available.description: Defaults to true. Held weapons, shields and other items never prevent spell gestures, in or out of combat. Set false only when the scene prevents the caster from moving enough to gesture.

cfd8765f49d42832.description: Spend the next casting Magic action, or advance uninterrupted exploration rounds. Casting fails if concentration breaks or a required combat turn is missed.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: control_srd_mage_hand
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Spend the actual later Magic action to move and manipulate the saved spectral hand. Outside combat, Mage Hand uses current fictional placement, nearest caster separation and actual clear-path/contact facts, including its cargo and shared plane. No combat turn or map is required. A later Magic action advances ordinary time by one round; the hand moves at most 30 feet and vanishes beyond 30 feet from its caster.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: dismiss_srd_divination_spell
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Dismiss one exact source-owned time-span spell without an action.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: dismiss_srd_etherealness
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Dismiss this caster's ongoing Etherealness with no action under SRD time-span rules.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: dismiss_srd_illumination_spell
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Dismiss this caster's selected illumination effect, preserving every independent source.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: dismiss_srd_information_spell
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Dismiss this caster's information spell without an action.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: dismiss_srd_senses_spell
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Dismiss only this caster's saved time-span senses spell without spending an action. An Incapacitated caster cannot dismiss it. Native senses and other casters' grants remain active.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: dismiss_srd_spell
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Dismiss one selected actual ongoing time-span cast without spending an action. Its cast ID comes from the casting result; legacy records without that identity cannot be grouped by caster, spell, or tick.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: dismount_srd_otherworldly_steed
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Dismount the actual Otherworldly Steed to an unoccupied supported space within five feet. Outside combat, supply the actual current mount_placement, mount_current_plane, mount_same_plane=true, nearest mount_distance_feet within five feet, mount_clear_path=true and mount_space_unoccupied=true. For dismounting, also name dismount_placement and establish dismount_ground_supported=true. These current fictional facts do not create coordinates or an exploration movement budget. The rider must still be able to spend half their current Speed. Combat continues to use saved bodies, actual supporting ground and the original movement payment. If Spirit Guardians is active in the world, supply the current established mount_guardian_speed_halved fact for this exact rider; an unrelated source does not halve the rider's Speed.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: disperse_srd_fog
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Disperse an actual fog source using a strong-wind zone admitted to the scene.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: end_concentration
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Voluntarily end the selected creature's current package-owned concentration without spending an action.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: escape_srd_nonmagical_restraint
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Spend five feet of movement to escape a saved nonmagical restraint or Grapple under Freedom of Movement.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: escape_srd_web
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Spend an Action on the source DC Strength (Athletics) check to escape Web.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: establish_srd_lite_steed_healing_proximity
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Establish this owned active Steed's current fictional proximity for one imminent spell healing event. Use current nearest separation, including vertical separation, and actual shared-plane knowledge; never reuse birth distance. This is a fact declaration, not movement or healing.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: inspect_srd_minor_world_effects
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Read actual active minor world sources affecting an object or actual caster.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: level_up_srd_character

build.description: Complete resulting build. Resulting walking Speed after the new class features and worn equipment. The engine derives it from the retained base species Speed; do not change that base.

character_state.description: The same character ID, selecting its live mechanical state.

choices_summary.description: Explain all gains and choices to the player; at most 1000 characters.

cfd8765f49d42832.description:
Apply one earned or queued starting SRD level. Read the retained class level, subclass, feat and spell rules; resolve every player choice before proposing the build. Provide complete proficiency lists preserving existing grants and all new features. The player confirms the proposal. Feature records are not automatic feature execution.
Selected spell headers restrict eligible choices. Full complete-grant and earned-level requirements remain unchanged; initial character validation describes available choices and reports current repertoire shortfalls. Pending profiles cannot fill missing choices. Gameplay verification remains pending. Supply resulting AC and walking Speed; the engine validates both against new class features and worn equipment while retaining base species Speed.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: mount_srd_otherworldly_steed
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Mount the actual willing Otherworldly Steed, spending half the rider's current Speed. Outside combat, supply the actual current mount_placement, mount_current_plane, mount_same_plane=true, nearest mount_distance_feet within five feet, mount_clear_path=true and mount_space_unoccupied=true. For dismounting, also name dismount_placement and establish dismount_ground_supported=true. These current fictional facts do not create coordinates or an exploration movement budget. The rider must still be able to spend half their current Speed. Combat continues to use saved bodies, actual supporting ground and the original movement payment. If Spirit Guardians is active in the world, supply the current established mount_guardian_speed_halved fact for this exact rider; an unrelated source does not halve the rider's Speed.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: move_srd_scene_creature
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Combat only. Follow a legal creature-space route and consume its actual movement cost.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: observe_srd_information_proxy
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Observe an active invisible sensor with actual observer senses and scene obstruction.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: operate_srd_information_proxy
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Move Arcane Eye or switch Clairvoyance's sense using its actual Bonus Action.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: pause_srd_controlled_steed_phase
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Pause the controlled Steed and resume its rider's existing turn budget. The Steed can resume later on this rider turn with the movement and actions it has left.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: prepare_srd_creature
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Prepare one new NPC or monster from a read Plan/Setting stat block, or an explicitly recorded GM adjudication, before starting combat. This creates authoritative creature state; narrative characters do not create it. Use one stable ID per individual. Existing identities and Player Characters/Companions are rejected without resetting them. Copy source defenses and any known save modifiers. This does not automate unencoded traits or an entire stat block. After success, start the intended encounter with this ID and the admitted party IDs before narrating its result. For spellcasters, copy the listed spells, casting statistics and per-day uses from the source. Zero uses_per_day means at will. Do not infer spell slots or cantrip scaling from Challenge Rating.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: prepare_srd_spell_object
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Classify an admitted object using SRD material AC and suggested average HP. For Huge or Gargantuan objects admit separate Large-or-smaller sections; whole-object collapse, thresholds and other magical adjustments are unsupported.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: prepare_srd_spells

spellbook_available.description: For Wizard preparation, confirm the character can access and study their spellbook.

spells.description: Complete replacement list for this source, including its unchanged spells and cantrips.

cfd8765f49d42832.description: At an earned rest's completion, apply the player's chosen replacement spells for one saved source. Preserve its cantrip and leveled-spell counts. Source rules enforce replacement limits and Wizard spellbook access; other grants and resource uses remain intact.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: prepare_srd_weapon_set
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Prepare actual carried weapons. This costs one Action during combat and is free outside combat. Off-hand attacks remain explicit.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: query_srd_information_spell
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Consume an active information spell using calculated scene facts and source-only outputs.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: query_srd_thunderwave_sound
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Query the recorded Thunderwave boom's fixed range and current Silence.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: read_srd_carried_item_size
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Read a carried item's size category adjustment from its actual resizing source.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: read_srd_creature_attitude
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Read effective attitude, preserving the underlying relationship during Calm Emotions.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: read_srd_passive_perception
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Calculate actual Passive Perception from the supplied base and active Enthrall penalty.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: read_srd_transformed_appearance
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Read the actual effective form; Truesight distinguishes its preserved original identity.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: read_srd_truth_zone_outcomes
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Return only this caster's saved actual truth-zone outcomes, including later successful saves.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_actor_base_size
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Retain base size from this creature's own validated Character File.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_banishment_plane
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record the GM's creature-type plane association using distinct admitted locations.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_body_vessel
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Bind actual prepared Clone vessel material to its scene object and physical interior.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_contingency_world_fact
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record an actual GM narrative occurrence for this caster's armed Contingency. Use native tools for HP, save, attack, damage and condition outcomes; this tag is a world fact.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_control_held_items
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record current held objects and their named attacks from admitted inventory/source facts before resolving control.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_creature_relationship
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record the scene's creature relationship used by hostility and witnessed-ally consequences.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_creature_skill_checks

skill_checks.description: Actual total NPC skill-check modifiers from the selected stat block. For an unlisted skill use its actual ability modifier. Omitted skills remain unknown; never guess them from saving throws.

cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record missing NPC skill-check totals from the creature's existing stat-block source. This adds facts without recreating the creature, changing already recorded modifiers, restoring HP or refreshing its Reaction. Use before a skill check when an older prepared NPC lacks that skill. Character checks derive their own modifiers and cannot use this operation.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_cursed_item
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Bind a cursed item's intrinsic curse and attunement to an actual inventory item.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_deceased_body
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record admitted historical death/body/soul facts; an actual recorded death time stays authoritative.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_demiplane_room_knowledge
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record knowledge of the nature and contents of an actual persistent room.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_earth_material
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record actual natural dirt, sand or clay for one existing terrain identity.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_find_path_location
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record fictional named-place knowledge against an actual admitted location anchor.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_find_path_routes
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record actual physical route lengths at this paid source's current place; do not supply a best-route verdict.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_food_and_drink
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Admit actual food, drink, poison and rot once; later classification cannot rewrite them.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_hand_sized_form
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Classify a fictional trinket or image as fitting this actual caster's hand, with its admitted depiction geometry.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_imprisonment_statuette
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record which actual creature a possessed Imprisonment statuette depicts.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_information_world_facts
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record GM-observed physical candidates at this named place and plane; no spell answer is supplied.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_levitate_object_looseness
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record whether the admitted object is physically loose.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_levitate_surface_grip
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record arm/contact reach fiction against an actual suspended body and fixed surface.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_life_event
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Admit one actual life event or empty historical window; preserve its original truth.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_lite_exploration_object
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Admit a new fictional object for Light/Mending or Fire Bolt outside combat, without map coordinates. Use existing record_srd_object_break/material/container tools for its physical facts. Break bounds are relative to the object: x/y centred on zero, z from zero to height. Existing scene or retained objects cannot be replaced. When included in a combat arena, use the same object ID and dimensions; reconciliation preserves its spell consequences.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_lite_steed_disappearance_facts
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Immediately before a Find Steed disappearance, establish its actual current placement/plane, rider height/clear descent and actual landing/cargo drop. This one-shot record is valid only at this native clock tick with these exact rider/item/native-arrival facts. A positive remaining fall uses the real saved fall/Feather Fall Reaction, paid casting and native protection clock. Declare current caster/target range and sight pairs for other Feather Fall casters; self needs no invented pair. This records facts without costs.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_local_weather_forecast
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Admit the GM's fictional local next-24-hour weather forecast at the actual caster location.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_magic_jar_container
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Bind Magic Jar's actual prepared 500 GP material lot to the possessed scene object.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_map_time_of_day
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record this admitted map plane's current day/night fact independently of any spell.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_minor_world_subject
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Admit an actual object's fictional kind, nonliving material and held-open facts once. Outside combat, the exact retained exploration object owns these facts.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_native_wight_body_destruction
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record observed destruction of this exact original corpse, without asserting death.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_object_access
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Admit mundane access facts for actual scenery; this cannot alter a magical lock.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_object_attachment
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record whether this existing object is physically fixed to a surface.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_object_break
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Admit one physical break or tear by its actual bounds; no HP or magic restoration verdict. Outside combat, retained exploration objects use their local physical facts; no map setup or movement is required.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_object_container
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Admit an actual vessel's physical capacity and existing water, once. Outside combat, retained exploration objects use their local physical facts; no map setup or movement is required.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_object_holder
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Admit the actual creature carrying or wearing this scene object outside combat.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_object_material
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Classify actual object material and raw stock; this cannot change a prepared damage profile. Outside combat, retained exploration objects use their local physical facts; no map setup or movement is required.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_object_utility_facts
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Classify an actual object's weight and manufacture once; no AC, HP or outcome verdicts.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_ordinary_flame
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Admit an actual ordinary flame and whether it is exposed to rain, once.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_planar_patron
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record a cosmic patron known to this caster and its actual loyal creatures (GM fiction).

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_reverse_gravity_anchoring
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Admit anchoring/grabbability fiction against actual creature or object scenery.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_rope_length
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Admit this actual rope object's physical length once, in feet.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_scene_hand_occupancy
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record actual hands and grasps for this body without changing equipment or Somatic facts.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_scene_sight_origin
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record a factual anatomical offset within the current creature's admitted body.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_secret_chest_components
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Bind the actual chest and Tiny replica to their existing priced specific material lots.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_severed_body_part
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record a severed body part as an explicit creature fact for later regrowth.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_soul_disposition
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record the actual individual's free and willing soul facts without asserting death or revival.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_spell_material_object
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Link one actual prepared sapphire material lot to its actual carried scene object.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_telekinesis_object_size
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record the actual admitted object's size category once.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_teleport_destination
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record the caster's descriptive familiarity with an actual destination anchor.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_teleport_similar_area
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record a visually or thematically similar place using two actual spatial anchors.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_water_body
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Admit water and standing/flowing fiction on one real clear passable Box geometry.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_water_vehicle
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record actual vehicle identity and size on an existing non-creature scene object.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: record_srd_wind_flame_protection
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record actual mundane wind protection on an already admitted ordinary flame, once.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: release_srd_unresolved_spell_cast
cfd8765f49d42832.description: In combat, close an open casting window that complete_srd_pending_action refused and that no corrected input can complete. The cast fails without resolving: its Action stays used, no spell slot is spent, and a creature's reserved daily or feature use is settled as for a countered spell. Use it only after a refused completion, never to cancel a spell that can still resolve.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: resolve_srd_condition_saving_throw
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Roll a creature's saved ability modifier against a condition-causing source's DC; active timed defenses apply automatically. The caller still resolves the source's stated consequences.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: resolve_srd_control_activity
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Spend the actual task action, preserving activity until its completion is adjudicated.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: resolve_srd_control_order
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Perform prescribed movement through the admitted scene and shared movement budget.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: resolve_srd_fall
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Resolve one actual fall after the GM establishes its distance and landing surface. Roll 1d6 Bludgeoning per full 10 feet (maximum 20d6), apply shared defenses and HP consequences, and land Prone unless no damage is taken. Choose at most one Reaction; Slow Fall requires Monk level 4 and reduces damage by five times Monk level. A liquid landing permits a DC 15 Athletics or Acrobatics Reaction check to halve damage. Character modifiers are derived; NPC checks require saved skill totals from prepare_srd_creature or record_srd_creature_skill_checks. This records a fall, not movement or a voluntary action.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: resolve_srd_fear_turn
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Spend Fear's real Dash and scene movement, deriving source line of sight at the final position.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: resolve_srd_otherworldly_mount_balance
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Resolve the saved DC 10 Dexterity save after mounted Prone or before involuntary motion. Choose a clear off-mount position at the rider's actual height within five feet; a failed save opens the real fall.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: resolve_srd_scene_relation
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Calculate range, direction, sight and plane from admitted actor/target entries.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: resolve_srd_sight
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Resolve sight from declared scene facts and saved native/spell senses. For objects omit subject_state. Use a test only for a meaningful uncertain Perception check or a visual-illusion saving throw; the GM supplies fictional appearance and actual illusion content.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: restore_srd_resource
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Restore a package-owned resource. For class Hit Dice, select hit_die_class for a partial change; restoring the full total restores every class pool.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: set_srd_illumination_cover
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Record actual opaque covering of an admitted light-source object; covering does not quench Continual Flame. Outside combat, retained exploration objects use their local physical facts; no map setup or movement is required.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: set_srd_respiration
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Declare a creature's actual respiration medium and choking. The engine derives breath capacity from its saved Constitution or validated Character File, retains native air/water modes, and consumes Water Breathing at later time and turn boundaries.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: set_srd_rest_activity
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Change ordinary rest activity or resume an interrupted Long Rest. Sleep applies Unconscious and ends concentration; light activity is reading, talking, eating or watch. Exertion does not count as rest, interrupts a Short Rest immediately, and interrupts a Long Rest after an accumulated hour. Cancel abandons the rest. Advance actual elapsed time separately for all resting creatures together.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: shake_srd_sleeping_creature

target_distance.description: Current target distance in feet when not supplied by saved combat geometry. Supply the established scene distance; self-targeting is distance zero.

cfd8765f49d42832.description: Spend an actual action to shake away selected Sleep sources.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: speak_srd_truth_zone
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Speak with an admitted fiction classification; exact failed zones prevent deliberate lies only inside.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: spend_srd_resource
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Spend a package-owned resource. For class Hit Dice, select hit_die_class for a partial change; restoring the full total restores every class pool. For Action Surge, call use_srd_action_surge instead: it also grants the action.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: stabilize_srd_creature
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Take the Help action to attempt ordinary first aid on a living, unstable creature at 0 HP able to receive physical first aid. Use the helper's actual Wisdom (Medicine) modifier; the native DC 10 check determines stabilization. Stabilization grants no HP and leaves Unconscious until recovery. This operation does not consume a Healer's Kit or simulate a healing spell.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: start_group_combat_encounter

uncanny_metabolism_users.description: Monk combatants choosing Uncanny Metabolism when Initiative is rolled: regain all Focus and heal Monk level plus the Martial Arts die, once per Long Rest. Leave empty to decline; eligible level-15 Monks then receive Perfect Focus automatically.

cfd8765f49d42832.description:
Roll Initiative once for every living creature taking part in a group encounter. Supply all player characters, GM-controlled companions, and hostiles that are present when combat starts. The engine owns the resulting order; never omit a present companion merely to fit the two-creature encounter operation.
Coordinate combat requires a saved spatial scene. For the first encounter, supply one scene in combat_scenes using the spatial_scene format 1 content definition: format=1; map with id, revision, bounds.min/max (three coordinates), grid.cell_size/unit='ft'/origin (two coordinates), and layers (id/min_elevation/max_elevation); entities, geometry, zones and terrain arrays. Each combatant needs exactly one active creature body: id, map_id, position (three coordinates), footprint (box.half_extents or circle.radius), height, facing (two coordinates), active, movement, visibility, and metadata with participant_ref equal to its saved actor ID, creature_type, plane and lighting. Choose physical positions and body dimensions from the encounter fiction; do not invent a target-distance substitute. Include known blockers and terrain. Declare metadata.player.label/kind only on bodies and geometry the player knows. 
Coordinate combat uses the saved spatial scene. Supply one combat_scenes entry when admitting a later roster or an actual new arena. Omit it to reuse the scene. For the same map ID, keep the existing bounds, grid and layers: all saved bodies, objects, blockers, zones and terrain remain authoritative; supplied rows with existing IDs do not edit or relocate them. New IDs add genuinely present scene facts. For a new map ID, explicitly place every accompanying saved body/object by its exact ID. Existing dimensions, activity and mechanic metadata are retained; only actual destination position, facing, plane and ambient lighting are admitted. Include active summons, carried/worn objects, and a live Mage Hand with its cargo and caster. Arena replacement is unavailable while an anchored object, wall panel including permanent Stone, retained coordinate area/terrain or anchored light needs its current scene. Those effects are preserved and the operation clearly rejects before initiative; do not remove them or substitute a different map ID to bypass this limit. Exploration does not require map movement.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: take_srd_otherworldly_steed_action
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Take Dash, Disengage or Dodge with the actual Otherworldly Steed's native Action budget. Enter its controlled phase first while the capable caster rides; an independent Steed uses its own active turn.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: take_srd_short_rest_hit_die
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Immediately after a tracked Short Rest completes, spend one Hit Die and apply its healing. Choose further dice after each result, before advancing time or resuming other activity. For mixed class pools, ask which class's die to spend and supply hit_die_class. Omit it for older single-die characters or a single class pool.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: transfer_srd_attack_mark
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Move a genuine earned curse or quarry mark with one later Bonus Action.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: traverse_srd_tree_stride
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Traverse living same-kind trees using Tree Stride's actual range, size, turn limit and movement costs.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: unbound_d20_test
cfd8765f49d42832.description: Resolve an SRD 5.2.1 D20 Test without a campaign participant. Supply the explicit ability modifier, proficiency bonus, proficiency factor, target number, and situational judgments.

cfd8765f49d42832.name: use_monk_wholeness_of_body

situations: People and truth. Corren knew repayment was overdue before telling Tavin it was settled. Eda legally acquired the pledge in good faith and spent money on a survey, but the plate is Lodge property Corren could not sell. Ysra wants the relic and an accurate record; her loyalty is not bought with a successful duel. At Eda’s camp, apprentice Myr is trapped behind the vault’s maintenance gate and foreman Kellin has escaped with a diagram. Eda offers to reduce her claim if Tavin rescues Myr and retrieves the crew’s instruments alongside the plate.

Compact vault. A camp approach enters B survey antechamber. From B, a guarded direct stair descends to D plate dais; a narrow maintenance passage reaches C counterweight room, then D from behind its pillar. E instrument store is barred from D and holds Myr. There is no world-altering Door here: the device projects local survey alignments and the plate supplies calibration marks. The scratched camp diagram identifies C, so a failed check never conceals the alternate route.

Antechamber defence. A damaged Warden Armor guards the direct stair. Its floor pattern includes a maintenance stripe; Intelligence (Investigation or Arcana) DC 12 interprets the worn symbol and permits a slow safe passage along that stripe. Failure leaves the symbol unclear, not the armour already attacking. Kellin’s diagram or spending time tracing the stripe from C supplies another way. Crossing the guarded stair without resolving its command starts the prepared fight. Spells act according to actual target restrictions; an enchantment valid against a humanoid does not necessarily affect a construct.

Rushing unsupported requires Dexterity save DC 11; failure causes 1d4 bludgeoning on a shallow fall and leaves the character below the walkway with a ladder route back. situations: A earned pause. Eda’s camp offers a secure short rest after the vault. The rival factor. Corren also promised the plate to collector Rusk to delay another demand. Rusk blocks a narrow stone causeway with one armed retainer. ## GM guidance

Run declared ability checks, saving throws, initiative, attacks, damage, conditions, spells and rests through the admitted D&D Ruleset. Before an uncertain roll name its purpose, DC and consequence. Give plainly visible facts and essential leads without a roll; success can improve position, speed or discretion. A supported spell or sound equipment use can solve an obstacle outright when its actual text allows. Track the real HP, spell slots, ammunition, carried gear and recovery resources; never restore them between scenes by narration. These Plans do not install extra engine procedures. The encounter profiles below are complete bounded GM adaptations for the stated baseline, not the full Setting stat blocks or certified CR ratings. Use only their listed attacks and traits. All have one action, no multiattack, legendary actions, resistances, immunities or unlisted spellcasting. Ordinary rules for movement, cover, opportunity attacks, surprise and surrender still apply. For an uncertain opposing ability check or save, use the listed modifiers without inventing proficiency. Before engagement, admit the actors through the current encounter tools and declare any supported additional trait. Never narrate a proprietary creature power as an automatic engine effect. Every encounter has a reason to occur and a way to withdraw, negotiate or gain an advantage. Honour a clever bypass as a mechanical success; preserve the wider hazardous adventure instead of forcing a replacement fight. Do not reduce this prepared adventure to a sequence of conversations.

Make the named main problem and its leads accessible. Read the current act and all linked objective conditions before framing its main quest and reassess when a required result occurs. All listed conditions and the closing event are required; explicit alternatives satisfy only their own condition. Optional scenes can be deferred without adding gates. A completed side job does not replace the main story. Do not fabricate success or mark unplayed later acts complete after an early departure.

The player chooses their actions, loyalties and risks. Refusal, failed checks, retreat, scouting, spell use and enemy surrender can change the route. A check resolves an uncertain action, not another person’s entire will.

Baseline: one level-1 Player Character with no Companions. A lower-level or badly depleted solo character should face one active enemy at a time and the reduced HP/damage option stated for the encounter; prepare that adjustment before initiative. For a small adventuring party, add at most one ordinary foe to a fight before it starts, or use an appropriate fully supported profile after inspecting the actual party. Larger parties need deliberate rebalancing. Character compatibility does not enforce level or establish balance. Allied workers supply information, ropes and agreed off-screen work; they never receive free player-character combat turns. Tavin Bell’s accepted Character File owns their actual equipment and class resources.

Use the authored sites, opposition, clues and consequences. Core clues have alternate routes; opening a door or making a routine observation never chooses the character’s next action. Later acts inherit actual resources, wounds, allies and evidence. Keep stakes local to this expedition, relic, crew or route: the Anchor Door mystery and world-scale climax belong to The Rift Awakening.

## Completion and aftermath

All required act objectives have reached their authored endings. An early departure can end play honestly, but does not count as completion of unplayed acts.

The returning party has passed Rusk's causeway challenge by force, agreement or the cart track, or a failed return has ended with an actual retreat and loss report reaching Ysra. Ysra receives the recovered plate or honest loss report. Record its current custody, Eda's adjusted claim, Rusk's claim, Myr's outcome and any remaining repayment owner; agreement need not make every claimant happy.

## Failure and withdrawal

Use the explicit failed-attempt outcome and closing report in the current objective. An intention to withdraw, an unrelated side task or delegation alone does not satisfy it. An early departure leaves unplayed later objectives unfinished.

Resolve defeat, unconsciousness, death and recovery under the selected Ruleset and agreed boundaries; no scripted rescue cancels committed results.

## Optional continuation

Further adventures require the player’s interest after this story has a complete ending. Surviving contacts and obligations can carry forward.

Listed creature profiles are weaker or specialised Setting adaptations with declared statistics. They do not assert support for unencoded powers from the original monster entries.

4476964561933812.name: start_combat_encounter_entities
4476964561933812.description:
Roll Initiative and establish an encounter between two canonical creature states. When combat is inactive and the player declares a hostile weapon attack against a known present creature, including a companion, you MUST call this operation before any player-facing prose and before resolving the attack, then follow the freshly exposed combat lifecycle and weapon-attack operations. Do not decide in prose that the attack misses, is deflected, or is de-escalated. Do not restate the scene or ask what the player does instead. Do not substitute an Athletics or other skill check for the attack.
Coordinate combat requires a saved spatial scene. For the first encounter, supply one scene in combat_scenes using the spatial_scene format 1 content definition: format=1; map with id, revision, bounds.min/max (three coordinates), grid.cell_size/unit='ft'/origin (two coordinates), and layers (id/min_elevation/max_elevation); entities, geometry, zones and terrain arrays. Each combatant needs exactly one active creature body: id, map_id, position (three coordinates), footprint (box.half_extents or circle.radius), height, facing (two coordinates), active, movement, visibility, and metadata with participant_ref equal to its saved actor ID, creature_type, plane and lighting. Choose physical positions and body dimensions from the encounter fiction; do not invent a target-distance substitute. Include known blockers and terrain. Declare metadata.player.label/kind only on bodies and geometry the player knows. 
Coordinate combat uses the saved spatial scene. Supply one combat_scenes entry when admitting a later roster or an actual new arena. Omit it to reuse the scene. For the same map ID, keep the existing bounds, grid and layers: all saved bodies, objects, blockers, zones and terrain remain authoritative; supplied rows with existing IDs do not edit or relocate them. New IDs add genuinely present scene facts. For a new map ID, explicitly place every accompanying saved body/object by its exact ID. Existing dimensions, activity and mechanic metadata are retained; only actual destination position, facing, plane and ambient lighting are admitted. Include active summons, carried/worn objects, and a live Mage Hand with its cargo and caster. Arena replacement is unavailable while an anchored object, wall panel including permanent Stone, retained coordinate area/terrain or anchored light needs its current scene. Those effects are preserved and the operation clearly rejects before initiative; do not remove them or substitute a different map ID to bypass this limit. Exploration does not require map movement.
