1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: At an earned rest's completion, apply the player's chosen replacement spells for one saved source. Preserve its cantrip and leveled-spell counts. Source rules enforce replacement limits and Wizard spellbook access; other grants and resource uses remain intact.

spellbook_available.description: For Wizard preparation, confirm the character can access and study their spellbook.

spells.description: Complete replacement list for this source, including its unchanged spells and cantrips.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: prepare_srd_weapon_set
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Prepare actual carried weapons. This costs one Action during combat and is free outside combat. Off-hand attacks remain explicit.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: query_srd_information_spell
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Consume an active information spell using calculated scene facts and source-only outputs.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: read_srd_carried_item_size
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Read a carried item's size category adjustment from its actual resizing source.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: read_srd_creature_attitude
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Read effective attitude, preserving the underlying relationship during Calm Emotions.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: read_srd_passive_perception
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Calculate actual Passive Perception from the supplied base and active Enthrall penalty.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_actor_base_size
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Retain base size from this creature's own validated Character File.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_control_held_items
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Record current held objects and their named attacks from admitted inventory/source facts before resolving control.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_creature_relationship
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Record the scene's creature relationship used by hostility and witnessed-ally consequences.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_creature_skill_checks
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Record missing NPC skill-check totals from the creature's existing stat-block source. This adds facts without recreating the creature, changing already recorded modifiers, restoring HP or refreshing its Reaction. Use before a skill check when an older prepared NPC lacks that skill. Character checks derive their own modifiers and cannot use this operation.

skill_checks.description: Actual total NPC skill-check modifiers from the selected stat block. For an unlisted skill use its actual ability modifier. Omitted skills remain unknown; never guess them from saving throws.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_cursed_item
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Bind a cursed item's intrinsic curse and attunement to an actual inventory item.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_deceased_body
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Record admitted historical death/body/soul facts; an actual recorded death time stays authoritative.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_earth_material
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Record actual natural dirt, sand or clay for one existing terrain identity.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_food_and_drink
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Admit actual food, drink, poison and rot once; later classification cannot rewrite them.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_hand_sized_form
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Classify a fictional trinket or image as fitting this actual caster's hand, with its admitted depiction geometry.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_information_world_facts
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Record GM-observed physical candidates at this named place and plane; no spell answer is supplied.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_life_event
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Admit one actual life event or empty historical window; preserve its original truth.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_lite_exploration_object
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Admit a new fictional object for Light/Mending or Fire Bolt outside combat, without map coordinates. Use existing record_srd_object_break/material/container tools for its physical facts. Break bounds are relative to the object: x/y centred on zero, z from zero to height. Existing scene or retained objects cannot be replaced. When included in a combat arena, use the same object ID and dimensions; reconciliation preserves its spell consequences.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_local_weather_forecast
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Admit the GM's fictional local next-24-hour weather forecast at the actual caster location.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_map_time_of_day
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Record this admitted map plane's current day/night fact independently of any spell.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_minor_world_subject
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Admit an actual object's fictional kind, nonliving material and held-open facts once. Outside combat, the exact retained exploration object owns these facts.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_object_access
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Admit mundane access facts for actual scenery; this cannot alter a magical lock.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_object_attachment
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Record whether this existing object is physically fixed to a surface.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_object_break
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Admit one physical break or tear by its actual bounds; no HP or magic restoration verdict. Outside combat, retained exploration objects use their local physical facts; no map setup or movement is required.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_object_container
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Admit an actual vessel's physical capacity and existing water, once. Outside combat, retained exploration objects use their local physical facts; no map setup or movement is required.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_object_holder
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Admit the actual creature carrying or wearing this scene object outside combat.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_object_material
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Classify actual object material and raw stock; this cannot change a prepared damage profile. Outside combat, retained exploration objects use their local physical facts; no map setup or movement is required.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_object_utility_facts
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Classify an actual object's weight and manufacture once; no AC, HP or outcome verdicts.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_ordinary_flame
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Admit an actual ordinary flame and whether it is exposed to rain, once.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_planar_patron
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Record a cosmic patron known to this caster and its actual loyal creatures (GM fiction).

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_rope_length
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Admit this actual rope object's physical length once, in feet.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_scene_hand_occupancy
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Record actual hands and grasps for this body without changing equipment or Somatic facts.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_scene_sight_origin
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Record a factual anatomical offset within the current creature's admitted body.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_severed_body_part
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Record a severed body part as an explicit creature fact for later regrowth.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_soul_disposition
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Record the actual individual's free and willing soul facts without asserting death or revival.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_spell_material_object
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Link one actual prepared sapphire material lot to its actual carried scene object.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_water_body
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Admit water and standing/flowing fiction on one real clear passable Box geometry.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_water_vehicle
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Record actual vehicle identity and size on an existing non-creature scene object.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: record_srd_wind_flame_protection
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Record actual mundane wind protection on an already admitted ordinary flame, once.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: release_srd_unresolved_spell_cast
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: In combat, close an open casting window that complete_srd_pending_action refused and that no corrected input can complete. The cast fails without resolving: its Action stays used, no spell slot is spent, and a creature's reserved daily or feature use is settled as for a countered spell. Use it only after a refused completion, never to cancel a spell that can still resolve.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: resolve_srd_condition_saving_throw
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Roll a creature's saved ability modifier against a condition-causing source's DC; active timed defenses apply automatically. The caller still resolves the source's stated consequences.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: resolve_srd_fall
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Resolve one actual fall after the GM establishes its distance and landing surface. Roll 1d6 Bludgeoning per full 10 feet (maximum 20d6), apply shared defenses and HP consequences, and land Prone unless no damage is taken. Choose at most one Reaction; Slow Fall requires Monk level 4 and reduces damage by five times Monk level. A liquid landing permits a DC 15 Athletics or Acrobatics Reaction check to halve damage. Character modifiers are derived; NPC checks require saved skill totals from prepare_srd_creature or record_srd_creature_skill_checks. This records a fall, not movement or a voluntary action.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: resolve_srd_scene_relation
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Calculate range, direction, sight and plane from admitted actor/target entries.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: resolve_srd_sight
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Resolve sight from declared scene facts and saved native/spell senses. For objects omit subject_state. Use a test only for a meaningful uncertain Perception check or a visual-illusion saving throw; the GM supplies fictional appearance and actual illusion content.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: restore_srd_resource
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Restore a package-owned resource. For class Hit Dice, select hit_die_class for a partial change; restoring the full total restores every class pool.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: set_srd_illumination_cover
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Record actual opaque covering of an admitted light-source object; covering does not quench Continual Flame. Outside combat, retained exploration objects use their local physical facts; no map setup or movement is required.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: set_srd_respiration
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Declare a creature's actual respiration medium and choking. The engine derives breath capacity from its saved Constitution or validated Character File, retains native air/water modes, and consumes Water Breathing at later time and turn boundaries.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: set_srd_rest_activity
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Change ordinary rest activity or resume an interrupted Long Rest. Sleep applies Unconscious and ends concentration; light activity is reading, talking, eating or watch. Exertion does not count as rest, interrupts a Short Rest immediately, and interrupts a Long Rest after an accumulated hour. Cancel abandons the rest. Advance actual elapsed time separately for all resting creatures together.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: spend_srd_resource
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Spend a package-owned resource. For class Hit Dice, select hit_die_class for a partial change; restoring the full total restores every class pool. For Action Surge, call use_srd_action_surge instead: it also grants the action.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: stabilize_srd_creature
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Take the Help action to attempt ordinary first aid on a living, unstable creature at 0 HP able to receive physical first aid. Use the helper's actual Wisdom (Medicine) modifier; the native DC 10 check determines stabilization. Stabilization grants no HP and leaves Unconscious until recovery. This operation does not consume a Healer's Kit or simulate a healing spell.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: start_group_combat_encounter
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description:
Roll Initiative once for every living creature taking part in a group encounter. Supply all player characters, GM-controlled companions, and hostiles that are present when combat starts. The engine owns the resulting order; never omit a present companion merely to fit the two-creature encounter operation.
Coordinate combat requires a saved spatial scene. For the first encounter, supply one scene in combat_scenes using the spatial_scene format 1 content definition: format=1; map with id, revision, bounds.min/max (three coordinates), grid.cell_size/unit='ft'/origin (two coordinates), and layers (id/min_elevation/max_elevation); entities, geometry, zones and terrain arrays. Each combatant needs exactly one active creature body: id, map_id, position (three coordinates), footprint (box.half_extents or circle.radius), height, facing (two coordinates), active, movement, visibility, and metadata with participant_ref equal to its saved actor ID, creature_type, plane and lighting. Choose physical positions and body dimensions from the encounter fiction; do not invent a target-distance substitute. Include known blockers and terrain. Declare metadata.player.label/kind only on bodies and geometry the player knows. 
Coordinate combat uses the saved spatial scene. Supply one combat_scenes entry when admitting a later roster or an actual new arena. Omit it to reuse the scene. For the same map ID, keep the existing bounds, grid and layers: all saved bodies, objects, blockers, zones and terrain remain authoritative; supplied rows with existing IDs do not edit or relocate them. New IDs add genuinely present scene facts. For a new map ID, explicitly place every accompanying saved body/object by its exact ID. Existing dimensions, activity and mechanic metadata are retained; only actual destination position, facing, plane and ambient lighting are admitted. Include active summons, carried/worn objects, and a live Mage Hand with its cargo and caster. Arena replacement is unavailable while an anchored object, wall panel including permanent Stone, retained coordinate area/terrain or anchored light needs its current scene. Those effects are preserved and the operation clearly rejects before initiative; do not remove them or substitute a different map ID to bypass this limit. Exploration does not require map movement.

uncanny_metabolism_users.description: Monk combatants choosing Uncanny Metabolism when Initiative is rolled: regain all Focus and heal Monk level plus the Martial Arts die, once per Long Rest. Leave empty to decline; eligible level-15 Monks then receive Perfect Focus automatically.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: take_srd_short_rest_hit_die
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Immediately after a tracked Short Rest completes, spend one Hit Die and apply its healing. Choose further dice after each result, before advancing time or resuming other activity. For mixed class pools, ask which class's die to spend and supply hit_die_class. Omit it for older single-die characters or a single class pool.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: unbound_d20_test
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Resolve an SRD 5.2.1 D20 Test without a campaign participant. Supply the explicit ability modifier, proficiency bonus, proficiency factor, target number, and situational judgments.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: use_srd_second_wind
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Use one Second Wind charge for a living Fighter and restore Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus Fighter level. In combat this atomically spends the active creature's granted Second Wind Bonus Action. The charge is spent even at full Hit Points.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: search_campaign_knowledge
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: READ-ONLY discovery: find a small set of exact Campaign State, Campaign Plan, Setting, Ruleset, or Character File references when you do not already know their IDs or paths. Results identify candidate references and provenance; they are not the facts themselves. Follow a relevant result with an exact read through read_campaign_reference. Campaign State remains current truth. Similar names may identify different records. If results are empty or irrelevant, refine with a known name/subject and source, or read an available index reference; do not infer that a fact does not exist.

query.description: A natural question or a person, place, subject, relationship, current location, rule, or prepared item.

sources.description: Optional authority sources to search. Omit to search every source available to this campaign.

offset.description: Follow next_offset with the same query, sources, and limit to continue a byte-bounded page. Restart at 0 if campaign_revision changes.

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: read_campaign_reference
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: READ-ONLY: retrieve current Campaign State or one additional available Plan, Setting, Ruleset, or Character File. A participant reference returns that admitted character's authored summary and structured baseline when available. This tool cannot update, write, save, or commit Campaign File state. Campaign State is current truth; Plan and Setting material are preparation and defaults. Read for a concrete missing fact that changes present adjudication, or consult Plan preparation when choosing a new situation, assessing objective completion, or closing an episode. Read the smallest relevant item, not to decorate or expand narration. Retrieved detail remains private unless the current action and vantage reveal it. Do not reread Plan or Setting material already projected into the current request. An ID, title or reference path does not include the source contents. For an engine-owned structured input format, read source engine_format, path spatial_scene before constructing a combat scene; it returns the installed schema, example and requirements.

path.description: For campaign_state prefer a stable Campaign File record ID from search_campaign_knowledge. 'current' reads all state and may exceed the byte bound in a mature campaign. For campaign_plan use 'structured' for the whole Plan, 'structured/structure/<act-id>' for one act, 'structured/objectives/<objective-id>' for one objective and its completion conditions, or 'readable'. For a longer readable Plan use 'readable/page/0' and follow the returned next_path; each page is bounded. For participant use its exact participant ID to retrieve that Character File. For campaign_setting or ruleset use an exact admitted package path. Append '#heading-slug' to read one Markdown section without reading the rest of its file. Large UTF-8 files return bounded '#text/<character-offset>' excerpts. Follow next_path or search_campaign_knowledge for a relevant excerpt. For engine_format use spatial_scene (the installed scene schema and example).

1a40ee389bd4f7f8.name: update_campaign_file
1a40ee389bd4f7f8.description: Use character_updates for Ruleset-declared ordinary inventory/currency bookkeeping. Read the participant campaign reference for current fields, exact schema and revision first; submit complete replacement field values preserving unrelated holdings. Narrative attributes/facts alone never change equipment or money. Send related character changes and transaction facts together; rejection saves neither. Do not narrate success before acceptance or call failure a stale panel. Combat outcomes require their mechanics. When inventory_updates is offered, it is the active fallback for this campaign. Read campaign_state path inventory for its current holdings and revision; establish owner/holder entities in the same call when needed. Use holdings to establish or correct counts and transfers to move existing quantities. Loans, storage and returns preserve ownership; only explicit gifts/sales change it. Never infer currency exchange rates or use the fallback to bypass a Ruleset rejection. Update your durable Campaign File to the complete decided post-action truth in effect when control returns to the player. If Sylvia is holding a player-facing response, review it against that truth before committing. Store every lasting truth the response establishes or changes, including newly introduced people, places, objects, clues, relationships, promises, knowledge, scene state, and Plan Progress together in one call. Record the GM-owned outcome, not a summary of the player's request and not transient atmosphere. Use Ruleset tools for mechanics. The whole update is validated and committed together before the player sees the response. Any player-facing response and this disposition must describe the same post-action truth. Sylvia releases a settled response only after this call succeeds; it must not advance beyond or contradict the admitted durable state. Set state_change to 'unchanged' and omit all state collections only when the response changes no durable Campaign File truth; that records an unchanged decision without creating a database revision. An unchanged assessment asserts that location, scene, time, physical positions, player or NPC decisions, knowledge, relationships, people, places, objects, reveals, and Plan status are all exactly unchanged from the supplied pre-action State. An unsuccessful outcome can still change location, time, knowledge, or scene facts; record those consequences even when the player's goal remains unmet. Restating supplied Campaign State is not a change. Omit unchanged collections; an included collection must contain at least one change.

f443022b6c81d471.name: start_combat_encounter_entities

first_surprised.description: True only when the first creature was unaware that combat was starting. Use false for a creature that declares the attack or is already watching, threatening, or ready to act.

second_surprised.description: True only when the second creature was unaware that combat was starting. Use false for a creature that is already watching, threatening, or ready to act.

uncanny_metabolism_users.description: Monk combatants choosing Uncanny Metabolism when Initiative is rolled: regain all Focus and heal Monk level plus the Martial Arts die, once per Long Rest. Leave empty to decline; eligible level-15 Monks then receive Perfect Focus automatically.

f443022b6c81d471.description:
Roll Initiative and establish an encounter between two canonical creature states. When combat is inactive and the player declares a hostile weapon attack against a known present creature, including a companion, you MUST call this operation before any player-facing prose and before resolving the attack, then follow the freshly exposed combat lifecycle and weapon-attack operations. Do not decide in prose that the attack misses, is deflected, or is de-escalated. Do not restate the scene or ask what the player does instead. Do not substitute an Athletics or other skill check for the attack.
Coordinate combat requires a saved spatial scene. For the first encounter, supply one scene in combat_scenes using the spatial_scene format 1 content definition: format=1; map with id, revision, bounds.min/max (three coordinates), grid.cell_size/unit='ft'/origin (two coordinates), and layers (id/min_elevation/max_elevation); entities, geometry, zones and terrain arrays. Each combatant needs exactly one active creature body: id, map_id, position (three coordinates), footprint (box.half_extents or circle.radius), height, facing (two coordinates), active, movement, visibility, and metadata with participant_ref equal to its saved actor ID, creature_type, plane and lighting. Choose physical positions and body dimensions from the encounter fiction; do not invent a target-distance substitute. Include known blockers and terrain. Declare metadata.player.label/kind only on bodies and geometry the player knows. 
Coordinate combat uses the saved spatial scene. Supply one combat_scenes entry when admitting a later roster or an actual new arena. Omit it to reuse the scene. For the same map ID, keep the existing bounds, grid and layers: all saved bodies, objects, blockers, zones and terrain remain authoritative; supplied rows with existing IDs do not edit or relocate them. New IDs add genuinely present scene facts. For a new map ID, explicitly place every accompanying saved body/object by its exact ID. Existing dimensions, activity and mechanic metadata are retained; only actual destination position, facing, plane and ambient lighting are admitted. Include active summons, carried/worn objects, and a live Mage Hand with its cargo and caster. Arena replacement is unavailable while an anchored object, wall panel including permanent Stone, retained coordinate area/terrain or anchored light needs its current scene. Those effects are preserved and the operation clearly rejects before initiative; do not remove them or substitute a different map ID to bypass this limit. Exploration does not require map movement.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: ability_check

finding_target.description: Actual creature this Wisdom Perception or Survival check attempts to find.

interaction_target.description: Creature this Charisma check socially interacts with; saved Charm Advantage is derived automatically.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Resolve an identified character's ability check without a skill, using a tool, or using a different ability with a skill when the situation warrants it. Name one of the six abilities and any applicable skill/tool. The engine derives ability and ordinary proficiency modifiers from the saved character. Relevant skill and tool proficiency together grant Advantage, never a second proficiency bonus. Use only for uncertain outcomes that matter. Use dedicated Hide, Search, Study, Influence or combat operations when their rules apply. This operation does not infer class features such as Expertise; adjudicate their documented effects explicitly.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: activate_srd_weapon_set
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Switch a prepared weapon set freely on this creature's own turn. Switching never restores an Action, attack, Light/Nick use or other resource.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: advance_srd_lasting_time
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Advance the bounded package-owned lasting-effect clock outside an encounter.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: advance_stable_recovery
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Advance the official 1d4-hour recovery clock for a Stable creature at 0 Hit Points.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: award_srd_advancement

award_id.description: Stable milestone ID, or unique XP event ID.

character_state.description: The same character ID, selecting its live mechanical state.

evidence.description: Played event satisfying the policy, including allocation.

xp.description: Allocated XP for this character; 0 for milestones.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Record a Plan milestone or allocated XP award once for this character. Read the policy and verify its trigger, timing and recipients first. Repeat for every eligible party member when the policy awards the whole party. An award does not apply a level or resolve player choices.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: begin_srd_character_attack

attack_ability.description: Match the selected weapon. A dart uses Dexterity and a quarterstaff uses Strength. Other finesse weapons permit either, ordinary melee or thrown weapons use Strength, and ordinary ranged weapons use Dexterity.

attack_mode.description: Match the selected weapon's legal use. A dart uses thrown, never melee; a quarterstaff uses melee. Use ranged only for a ranged weapon that is not being thrown.

other_wielded_weapons.description: Actual other weapon IDs wielded alongside the selected weapon, not everything carried. Supply every other held weapon; empty means none.

use_stunning_strike.description: Spend one Focus Point on a hit for Monk level 5 Stunning Strike, at most once this combat turn.

weapon.description: Omit for the clear active main-hand weapon. An explicit weapon must belong to the active prepared set. Ask the player to select an unresolved set rather than substitute another carried weapon.

wielding_two_handed.description: Saved equipped weapons determine actual hands; this legacy input cannot override an active prepared set.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Reserve the attack cost, resolve targeting, then retain its real roll for reactions.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: begin_srd_creature_attack

attack_distance.description: Actual distance to this target in feet.

attack_modifier.description: Signed d20 attack modifier from the admitted creature stat block or GM adaptation.

attack_name.description: Plain attack label from the admitted creature stat block or the GM's stated adaptation.

damage_expression.description: Damage dice only; select one exact enum value and do not include a modifier.

damage_modifier.description: Signed flat damage modifier applied after the damage dice.

long_range.description: Maximum ranged distance; for melee use the same value as normal_range.

normal_range.description: Melee reach or normal ranged distance in feet from the stat block or stated adaptation.

target.description: Exact authoritative entity ID of the living attack target; do not use its display name.

use_multiattack.description: Use a remaining named component of the creature's prepared Multiattack; true on every attack in that routine.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Reserve the attack cost, resolve targeting, then retain its real roll for reactions.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: begin_srd_rest
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Start a tracked Short or Long Rest at the current campaign time. Long Rests need eight hours including six hours asleep and at most two of light activity; after finishing one, wait sixteen hours before starting another. Use set_srd_rest_activity to change activity, resume interruptions or abandon it, and advance_srd_lasting_time once for elapsed time shared by the party.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: change_srd_character_shield
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Equip or remove a carried shield through the existing armor authority and its ordinary combat cost.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: change_srd_equipment
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Don or doff one carried armor or shield. Empty item removes the worn item; one item equips it. Remove an existing item before replacing it. Use established item type and magic bonus, never invent equipment. Armor uses its SRD don/doff minutes outside combat; a shield uses a Utilize action in combat or one round outside combat.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: change_srd_transformation
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Spend one Magic action to change the original eligible form or selected Animal Shapes subjects.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: communicate_srd_spell
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Consume spell-enabled communication and source-bounded information eligibility.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: complete_srd_pending_action
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description:
Complete the saved action after its reaction window without another roll or cost.
Outside combat, when this spell heals a caster with an active Otherworldly Steed, first call establish_srd_lite_steed_healing_proximity with that exact caster and Steed, their current established nearest separation in feet, and whether they currently share a plane. This fact authorizes one healing qualification at the current lasting tick; establish it immediately before the healing event. Birth placement is never current proximity. Combat Life Bond always measures the admitted actual bodies.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: complete_srd_rest
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Complete a tracked rest after the clock and activity requirements are met. Restore encoded class resources or NPC per-day spells; a Long Rest also restores HP and Hit Dice, removes ordinary Temporary HP and reduces recoverable Exhaustion. Short Rest Hit Dice remain a separate player choice. Missing resource maxima are never invented.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: continue_srd_extended_spell_action

somatic_component_available.description: Defaults to true. Held weapons, shields and other items never prevent spell gestures, in or out of combat. Set false only when the scene prevents the caster from moving enough to gesture.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Perform this longer casting or Ritual action, then leave its actual Counterspell window open. Complete the saved window before further casting progress.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: continue_srd_spell_cast

somatic_component_available.description: Defaults to true. Held weapons, shields and other items never prevent spell gestures, in or out of combat. Set false only when the scene prevents the caster from moving enough to gesture.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Spend the next casting Magic action, or advance uninterrupted exploration rounds. Casting fails if concentration breaks or a required combat turn is missed.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: d20_test

finding_target.description: Actual creature this Wisdom Perception or Survival check attempts to find.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Resolve an SRD 5.2.1 skill check for a campaign character. Choose the participant, skill, target number, circumstantial modifier, sensory requirements, and applicable advantage or disadvantage. Sylvia derives the entity state, ability, and proficiency from authority. Call this only when success or failure is genuinely uncertain and matters to play. Routine description of immediately obvious surroundings needs no check; a general look around is not by itself a Perception check. Use Perception when detecting something concealed or otherwise uncertain would produce a meaningful different outcome. Never substitute this skill check for a weapon attack, spell attack, or other mechanic with its own exposed operation. Use ability_check for a check without a skill, with a tool, or with a situationally appropriate different ability.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: dismiss_srd_divination_spell
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Dismiss one exact source-owned time-span spell without an action.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: dismiss_srd_information_spell
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Dismiss this caster's information spell without an action.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: dismiss_srd_senses_spell
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Dismiss only this caster's saved time-span senses spell without spending an action. An Incapacitated caster cannot dismiss it. Native senses and other casters' grants remain active.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: dismiss_srd_spell
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Dismiss one selected actual ongoing time-span cast without spending an action. Its cast ID comes from the casting result; legacy records without that identity cannot be grouped by caster, spell, or tick.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: end_concentration
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Voluntarily end the selected creature's current package-owned concentration without spending an action.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: level_up_srd_character

build.description: Complete resulting build. Resulting walking Speed after the new class features and worn equipment. The engine derives it from the retained base species Speed; do not change that base.

character_state.description: The same character ID, selecting its live mechanical state.

choices_summary.description: Explain all gains and choices to the player; at most 1000 characters.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description:
Apply one earned or queued starting SRD level. Read the retained class level, subclass, feat and spell rules; resolve every player choice before proposing the build. Provide complete proficiency lists preserving existing grants and all new features. The player confirms the proposal. Feature records are not automatic feature execution.
Selected spell headers restrict eligible choices. Full complete-grant and earned-level requirements remain unchanged; initial character validation describes available choices and reports current repertoire shortfalls. Pending profiles cannot fill missing choices. Gameplay verification remains pending. Supply resulting AC and walking Speed; the engine validates both against new class features and worn equipment while retaining base species Speed.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: move_srd_scene_creature
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Combat only. Follow a legal creature-space route and consume its actual movement cost.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: prepare_srd_creature
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Prepare one new NPC or monster from a read Plan/Setting stat block, or an explicitly recorded GM adjudication, before starting combat. This creates authoritative creature state; narrative characters do not create it. Use one stable ID per individual. Existing identities and Player Characters/Companions are rejected without resetting them. Copy source defenses and any known save modifiers. This does not automate unencoded traits or an entire stat block. After success, start the intended encounter with this ID and the admitted party IDs before narrating its result. For spellcasters, copy the listed spells, casting statistics and per-day uses from the source. Zero uses_per_day means at will. Do not infer spell slots or cantrip scaling from Challenge Rating.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: prepare_srd_spell_object
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Classify an admitted object using SRD material AC and suggested average HP. For Huge or Gargantuan objects admit separate Large-or-smaller sections; whole-object collapse, thresholds and other magical adjustments are unsupported.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: prepare_srd_spells

spellbook_available.description: For Wizard preparation, confirm the character can access and study their spellbook.

spells.description: Complete replacement list for this source, including its unchanged spells and cantrips.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: At an earned rest's completion, apply the player's chosen replacement spells for one saved source. Preserve its cantrip and leveled-spell counts. Source rules enforce replacement limits and Wizard spellbook access; other grants and resource uses remain intact.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: prepare_srd_weapon_set
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Prepare actual carried weapons. This costs one Action during combat and is free outside combat. Off-hand attacks remain explicit.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: query_srd_information_spell
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Consume an active information spell using calculated scene facts and source-only outputs.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: read_srd_carried_item_size
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Read a carried item's size category adjustment from its actual resizing source.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: read_srd_creature_attitude
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Read effective attitude, preserving the underlying relationship during Calm Emotions.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: read_srd_passive_perception
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Calculate actual Passive Perception from the supplied base and active Enthrall penalty.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_actor_base_size
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Retain base size from this creature's own validated Character File.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_control_held_items
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Record current held objects and their named attacks from admitted inventory/source facts before resolving control.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_creature_relationship
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Record the scene's creature relationship used by hostility and witnessed-ally consequences.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_creature_skill_checks

skill_checks.description: Actual total NPC skill-check modifiers from the selected stat block. For an unlisted skill use its actual ability modifier. Omitted skills remain unknown; never guess them from saving throws.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Record missing NPC skill-check totals from the creature's existing stat-block source. This adds facts without recreating the creature, changing already recorded modifiers, restoring HP or refreshing its Reaction. Use before a skill check when an older prepared NPC lacks that skill. Character checks derive their own modifiers and cannot use this operation.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_cursed_item
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Bind a cursed item's intrinsic curse and attunement to an actual inventory item.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_deceased_body
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Record admitted historical death/body/soul facts; an actual recorded death time stays authoritative.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_earth_material
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Record actual natural dirt, sand or clay for one existing terrain identity.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_food_and_drink
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Admit actual food, drink, poison and rot once; later classification cannot rewrite them.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_hand_sized_form
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Classify a fictional trinket or image as fitting this actual caster's hand, with its admitted depiction geometry.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_information_world_facts
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Record GM-observed physical candidates at this named place and plane; no spell answer is supplied.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_life_event
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Admit one actual life event or empty historical window; preserve its original truth.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_lite_exploration_object
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Admit a new fictional object for Light/Mending or Fire Bolt outside combat, without map coordinates. Use existing record_srd_object_break/material/container tools for its physical facts. Break bounds are relative to the object: x/y centred on zero, z from zero to height. Existing scene or retained objects cannot be replaced. When included in a combat arena, use the same object ID and dimensions; reconciliation preserves its spell consequences.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_local_weather_forecast
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Admit the GM's fictional local next-24-hour weather forecast at the actual caster location.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_map_time_of_day
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Record this admitted map plane's current day/night fact independently of any spell.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_minor_world_subject
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Admit an actual object's fictional kind, nonliving material and held-open facts once. Outside combat, the exact retained exploration object owns these facts.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_object_access
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Admit mundane access facts for actual scenery; this cannot alter a magical lock.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_object_attachment
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Record whether this existing object is physically fixed to a surface.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_object_break
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Admit one physical break or tear by its actual bounds; no HP or magic restoration verdict. Outside combat, retained exploration objects use their local physical facts; no map setup or movement is required.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_object_container
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Admit an actual vessel's physical capacity and existing water, once. Outside combat, retained exploration objects use their local physical facts; no map setup or movement is required.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_object_holder
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Admit the actual creature carrying or wearing this scene object outside combat.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_object_material
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Classify actual object material and raw stock; this cannot change a prepared damage profile. Outside combat, retained exploration objects use their local physical facts; no map setup or movement is required.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_object_utility_facts
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Classify an actual object's weight and manufacture once; no AC, HP or outcome verdicts.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_ordinary_flame
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Admit an actual ordinary flame and whether it is exposed to rain, once.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_planar_patron
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Record a cosmic patron known to this caster and its actual loyal creatures (GM fiction).

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_rope_length
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Admit this actual rope object's physical length once, in feet.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_scene_hand_occupancy
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Record actual hands and grasps for this body without changing equipment or Somatic facts.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_scene_sight_origin
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Record a factual anatomical offset within the current creature's admitted body.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_severed_body_part
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Record a severed body part as an explicit creature fact for later regrowth.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_soul_disposition
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Record the actual individual's free and willing soul facts without asserting death or revival.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_spell_material_object
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Link one actual prepared sapphire material lot to its actual carried scene object.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_water_body
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Admit water and standing/flowing fiction on one real clear passable Box geometry.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_water_vehicle
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Record actual vehicle identity and size on an existing non-creature scene object.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: record_srd_wind_flame_protection
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Record actual mundane wind protection on an already admitted ordinary flame, once.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: release_srd_unresolved_spell_cast
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: In combat, close an open casting window that complete_srd_pending_action refused and that no corrected input can complete. The cast fails without resolving: its Action stays used, no spell slot is spent, and a creature's reserved daily or feature use is settled as for a countered spell. Use it only after a refused completion, never to cancel a spell that can still resolve.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: resolve_srd_condition_saving_throw
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Roll a creature's saved ability modifier against a condition-causing source's DC; active timed defenses apply automatically. The caller still resolves the source's stated consequences.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: resolve_srd_fall
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Resolve one actual fall after the GM establishes its distance and landing surface. Roll 1d6 Bludgeoning per full 10 feet (maximum 20d6), apply shared defenses and HP consequences, and land Prone unless no damage is taken. Choose at most one Reaction; Slow Fall requires Monk level 4 and reduces damage by five times Monk level. A liquid landing permits a DC 15 Athletics or Acrobatics Reaction check to halve damage. Character modifiers are derived; NPC checks require saved skill totals from prepare_srd_creature or record_srd_creature_skill_checks. This records a fall, not movement or a voluntary action.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: resolve_srd_scene_relation
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Calculate range, direction, sight and plane from admitted actor/target entries.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: resolve_srd_sight
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Resolve sight from declared scene facts and saved native/spell senses. For objects omit subject_state. Use a test only for a meaningful uncertain Perception check or a visual-illusion saving throw; the GM supplies fictional appearance and actual illusion content.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: restore_srd_resource
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Restore a package-owned resource. For class Hit Dice, select hit_die_class for a partial change; restoring the full total restores every class pool.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: set_srd_illumination_cover
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Record actual opaque covering of an admitted light-source object; covering does not quench Continual Flame. Outside combat, retained exploration objects use their local physical facts; no map setup or movement is required.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: set_srd_respiration
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Declare a creature's actual respiration medium and choking. The engine derives breath capacity from its saved Constitution or validated Character File, retains native air/water modes, and consumes Water Breathing at later time and turn boundaries.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: set_srd_rest_activity
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Change ordinary rest activity or resume an interrupted Long Rest. Sleep applies Unconscious and ends concentration; light activity is reading, talking, eating or watch. Exertion does not count as rest, interrupts a Short Rest immediately, and interrupts a Long Rest after an accumulated hour. Cancel abandons the rest. Advance actual elapsed time separately for all resting creatures together.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: spend_srd_resource
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Spend a package-owned resource. For class Hit Dice, select hit_die_class for a partial change; restoring the full total restores every class pool. For Action Surge, call use_srd_action_surge instead: it also grants the action.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: stabilize_srd_creature
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Take the Help action to attempt ordinary first aid on a living, unstable creature at 0 HP able to receive physical first aid. Use the helper's actual Wisdom (Medicine) modifier; the native DC 10 check determines stabilization. Stabilization grants no HP and leaves Unconscious until recovery. This operation does not consume a Healer's Kit or simulate a healing spell.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: start_group_combat_encounter

uncanny_metabolism_users.description: Monk combatants choosing Uncanny Metabolism when Initiative is rolled: regain all Focus and heal Monk level plus the Martial Arts die, once per Long Rest. Leave empty to decline; eligible level-15 Monks then receive Perfect Focus automatically.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description:
Roll Initiative once for every living creature taking part in a group encounter. Supply all player characters, GM-controlled companions, and hostiles that are present when combat starts. The engine owns the resulting order; never omit a present companion merely to fit the two-creature encounter operation.
Coordinate combat requires a saved spatial scene. For the first encounter, supply one scene in combat_scenes using the spatial_scene format 1 content definition: format=1; map with id, revision, bounds.min/max (three coordinates), grid.cell_size/unit='ft'/origin (two coordinates), and layers (id/min_elevation/max_elevation); entities, geometry, zones and terrain arrays. Each combatant needs exactly one active creature body: id, map_id, position (three coordinates), footprint (box.half_extents or circle.radius), height, facing (two coordinates), active, movement, visibility, and metadata with participant_ref equal to its saved actor ID, creature_type, plane and lighting. Choose physical positions and body dimensions from the encounter fiction; do not invent a target-distance substitute. Include known blockers and terrain. Declare metadata.player.label/kind only on bodies and geometry the player knows. 
Coordinate combat uses the saved spatial scene. Supply one combat_scenes entry when admitting a later roster or an actual new arena. Omit it to reuse the scene. For the same map ID, keep the existing bounds, grid and layers: all saved bodies, objects, blockers, zones and terrain remain authoritative; supplied rows with existing IDs do not edit or relocate them. New IDs add genuinely present scene facts. For a new map ID, explicitly place every accompanying saved body/object by its exact ID. Existing dimensions, activity and mechanic metadata are retained; only actual destination position, facing, plane and ambient lighting are admitted. Include active summons, carried/worn objects, and a live Mage Hand with its cargo and caster. Arena replacement is unavailable while an anchored object, wall panel including permanent Stone, retained coordinate area/terrain or anchored light needs its current scene. Those effects are preserved and the operation clearly rejects before initiative; do not remove them or substitute a different map ID to bypass this limit. Exploration does not require map movement.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: take_srd_short_rest_hit_die
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Immediately after a tracked Short Rest completes, spend one Hit Die and apply its healing. Choose further dice after each result, before advancing time or resuming other activity. For mixed class pools, ask which class's die to spend and supply hit_die_class. Omit it for older single-die characters or a single class pool.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: unbound_d20_test
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Resolve an SRD 5.2.1 D20 Test without a campaign participant. Supply the explicit ability modifier, proficiency bonus, proficiency factor, target number, and situational judgments.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: use_srd_second_wind
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Use one Second Wind charge for a living Fighter and restore Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus Fighter level. In combat this atomically spends the active creature's granted Second Wind Bonus Action. The charge is spent even at full Hit Points.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: search_campaign_knowledge

query.description: A natural question or a person, place, subject, relationship, current location, rule, or prepared item.

sources.description: Optional authority sources to search. Omit to search every source available to this campaign.

offset.description: Follow next_offset with the same query, sources, and limit to continue a byte-bounded page. Restart at 0 if campaign_revision changes.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: READ-ONLY discovery: find a small set of exact Campaign State, Campaign Plan, Setting, Ruleset, or Character File references when you do not already know their IDs or paths. Results identify candidate references and provenance; they are not the facts themselves. Follow a relevant result with an exact read through read_campaign_reference. Campaign State remains current truth. Similar names may identify different records. If results are empty or irrelevant, refine with a known name/subject and source, or read an available index reference; do not infer that a fact does not exist.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: read_campaign_reference

path.description: For campaign_state prefer a stable Campaign File record ID from search_campaign_knowledge. 'current' reads all state and may exceed the byte bound in a mature campaign. For campaign_plan use 'structured' for the whole Plan, 'structured/structure/<act-id>' for one act, 'structured/objectives/<objective-id>' for one objective and its completion conditions, or 'readable'. For a longer readable Plan use 'readable/page/0' and follow the returned next_path; each page is bounded. For participant use its exact participant ID to retrieve that Character File. For campaign_setting or ruleset use an exact admitted package path. Append '#heading-slug' to read one Markdown section without reading the rest of its file. Large UTF-8 files return bounded '#text/<character-offset>' excerpts. Follow next_path or search_campaign_knowledge for a relevant excerpt. For engine_format use spatial_scene (the installed scene schema and example).

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: READ-ONLY: retrieve current Campaign State or one additional available Plan, Setting, Ruleset, or Character File. A participant reference returns that admitted character's authored summary and structured baseline when available. This tool cannot update, write, save, or commit Campaign File state. Campaign State is current truth; Plan and Setting material are preparation and defaults. Read for a concrete missing fact that changes present adjudication, or consult Plan preparation when choosing a new situation, assessing objective completion, or closing an episode. Read the smallest relevant item, not to decorate or expand narration. Retrieved detail remains private unless the current action and vantage reveal it. Do not reread Plan or Setting material already projected into the current request. An ID, title or reference path does not include the source contents. For an engine-owned structured input format, read source engine_format, path spatial_scene before constructing a combat scene; it returns the installed schema, example and requirements.

5ab53f9a1008ffaf.name: update_campaign_file
5ab53f9a1008ffaf.description: Use character_updates for Ruleset-declared ordinary inventory/currency bookkeeping. Read the participant campaign reference for current fields, exact schema and revision first; submit complete replacement field values preserving unrelated holdings. Narrative attributes/facts alone never change equipment or money. Send related character changes and transaction facts together; rejection saves neither. Do not narrate success before acceptance or call failure a stale panel. Combat outcomes require their mechanics. When inventory_updates is offered, it is the active fallback for this campaign. Read campaign_state path inventory for its current holdings and revision; establish owner/holder entities in the same call when needed. Use holdings to establish or correct counts and transfers to move existing quantities. Loans, storage and returns preserve ownership; only explicit gifts/sales change it. Never infer currency exchange rates or use the fallback to bypass a Ruleset rejection. Update your durable Campaign File to the complete decided post-action truth in effect when control returns to the player. If Sylvia is holding a player-facing response, review it against that truth before committing. Store every lasting truth the response establishes or changes, including newly introduced people, places, objects, clues, relationships, promises, knowledge, scene state, and Plan Progress together in one call. Record the GM-owned outcome, not a summary of the player's request and not transient atmosphere. Use Ruleset tools for mechanics. The whole update is validated and committed together before the player sees the response. Any player-facing response and this disposition must describe the same post-action truth. Sylvia releases a settled response only after this call succeeds; it must not advance beyond or contradict the admitted durable state. Set state_change to 'unchanged' and omit all state collections only when the response changes no durable Campaign File truth; that records an unchanged decision without creating a database revision. An unchanged assessment asserts that location, scene, time, physical positions, player or NPC decisions, knowledge, relationships, people, places, objects, reveals, and Plan status are all exactly unchanged from the supplied pre-action State. An unsuccessful outcome can still change location, time, knowledge, or scene facts; record those consequences even when the player's goal remains unmet. Restating supplied Campaign State is not a change. Omit unchanged collections; an included collection must contain at least one change.

advancement.allocation: The Player Character and Companions start and remain at level 1. Story success, defeat, combat and optional jobs never award advancement. Grant only the adventure's actually earned money, possessions and narrative rewards. Any lower-level encounter-variant notes are authoring guidance for a separately revised Plan, not permission to override this declaration in play.
advancement.timing: This edition stays at level 1 throughout its authored adventure and optional continuation. It awards no XP or level increases; changing that policy requires an explicitly revised Plan.

facts.text: Tavin Bell signed a pledge involving a borrowed Warden survey plate to cover mentor Corren’s debt. The plate has not returned to the Lodge.
Salvage captain Eda Venn holds the pledge but lost access to the plate when a Warden vault sealed around her survey crew. Ysra requests its recovery and an honest account.
