08229ad886ac23fb.description: Record a factual anatomical offset within the current creature's admitted body.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: record_srd_secret_chest_components
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Bind the actual chest and Tiny replica to their existing priced specific material lots.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: record_srd_severed_body_part
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Record a severed body part as an explicit creature fact for later regrowth.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: record_srd_soul_disposition
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Record the actual individual's free and willing soul facts without asserting death or revival.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: record_srd_spell_material_object
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Link one actual prepared sapphire material lot to its actual carried scene object.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: record_srd_telekinesis_object_size
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Record the actual admitted object's size category once.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: record_srd_teleport_destination
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Record the caster's descriptive familiarity with an actual destination anchor.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: record_srd_teleport_similar_area
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Record a visually or thematically similar place using two actual spatial anchors.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: record_srd_water_body
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Admit water and standing/flowing fiction on one real clear passable Box geometry.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: record_srd_water_vehicle
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Record actual vehicle identity and size on an existing non-creature scene object.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: record_srd_wind_flame_protection
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Record actual mundane wind protection on an already admitted ordinary flame, once.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: release_srd_unresolved_spell_cast
08229ad886ac23fb.description: In combat, close an open casting window that complete_srd_pending_action refused and that no corrected input can complete. The cast fails without resolving: its Action stays used, no spell slot is spent, and a creature's reserved daily or feature use is settled as for a countered spell. Use it only after a refused completion, never to cancel a spell that can still resolve.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: resolve_adjudicated_creature_attack

attack_distance.description: Actual distance to this target in feet.

attack_modifier.description: Signed d20 attack modifier from the admitted creature stat block or GM adaptation.

attack_name.description: Plain attack label from the admitted creature stat block or the GM's stated adaptation.

damage_expression.description: Damage dice only; select one exact enum value and do not include a modifier.

damage_modifier.description: Signed flat damage modifier applied after the damage dice.

long_range.description: Maximum ranged distance; for melee use the same value as normal_range.

normal_range.description: Melee reach or normal ranged distance in feet from the stat block or stated adaptation.

target.description: Exact authoritative entity ID of the living attack target; do not use its display name.

use_multiattack.description: Use a remaining named component of the creature's prepared Multiattack; true on every attack in that routine.

08229ad886ac23fb.description: Resolve one current non-participant creature attack using GM-adjudicated values from its admitted Campaign Setting stat block. Use the exact target entity ID from authoritative campaign state and copy an allowed damage die expression exactly as listed in the schema.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: resolve_combat_attack

attack_ability.description: Match the selected weapon. A dart uses Dexterity and a quarterstaff uses Strength. Other finesse weapons permit either, ordinary melee or thrown weapons use Strength, and ordinary ranged weapons use Dexterity.

attack_mode.description: Match the selected weapon's legal use. A dart uses thrown, never melee; a quarterstaff uses melee. Use ranged only for a ranged weapon that is not being thrown.

other_wielded_weapons.description: Actual other weapon IDs wielded alongside the selected weapon, not everything carried. Supply every other held weapon; empty means none.

use_stunning_strike.description: Spend one Focus Point on a hit for Monk level 5 Stunning Strike, at most once this combat turn.

weapon.description: Omit for the clear active main-hand weapon. An explicit weapon must belong to the active prepared set. Ask the player to select an unresolved set rather than substitute another carried weapon.

wielding_two_handed.description: Saved equipped weapons determine actual hands; this legacy input cannot override an active prepared set.

08229ad886ac23fb.description: Resolve one SRD weapon attack, spending a new Attack action only when no Extra Attack remains from the traced weapon catalog.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: resolve_combat_attack_followup

attack_ability.description: Match the selected weapon. A dart uses Dexterity and a quarterstaff uses Strength. Other finesse weapons permit either, ordinary melee or thrown weapons use Strength, and ordinary ranged weapons use Dexterity.

attack_mode.description: Match the selected weapon's legal use. A dart uses thrown, never melee; a quarterstaff uses melee. Use ranged only for a ranged weapon that is not being thrown.

other_wielded_weapons.description: Actual other weapon IDs wielded alongside the selected weapon, not everything carried. Supply every other held weapon; empty means none.

use_stunning_strike.description: Spend one Focus Point on a hit for Monk level 5 Stunning Strike, at most once this combat turn.

weapon.description: Omit for the clear active main-hand weapon. An explicit weapon must belong to the active prepared set. Ask the player to select an unresolved set rather than substitute another carried weapon.

wielding_two_handed.description: Saved equipped weapons determine actual hands; this legacy input cannot override an active prepared set.

08229ad886ac23fb.description: Resolve the optional second attack after a primary Light-weapon attack. Use only attack_sequence light_bonus or light_nick with a different Light weapon; the Ruleset checks the remaining Bonus Action, Nick mastery, weapon choice, and all ordinary attack inputs.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: resolve_monk_bonus_strike

open_hand_effect.description: Warrior of the Open Hand level 3: optionally impose one technique if this Flurry damage attack hits. Push/Topple saves use Wisdom and the engine-owned DC; no additional Focus cost.

open_hand_push_feet.description: Actual selected push distance up to 15 feet, accounting for the physical surroundings.

other_wielded_weapons.description: Actual weapon IDs currently wielded while making the Unarmed Strike, not everything carried. Supply every held weapon; empty means no weapon is wielded. The engine checks ownership and Monk weapon categories.

unarmed_damage_type.description: Choose Force only for a damaging Unarmed Strike with Monk level 6 Empowered Strikes. Grapple and Shove do not deal this damage.

use_stunning_strike.description: Spend one Focus Point on a hit for Monk level 5 Stunning Strike, at most once this combat turn.

08229ad886ac23fb.description: Resolve one Monk Bonus Action Unarmed Strike: Martial Arts grants one eligible strike, or Flurry of Blows spends one Focus Point for two strikes (three from Monk level 10). Use flurry_followup for each remaining strike, choosing its target and Damage/Grapple/Shove effect. This never spends the normal Action. Strength is the default; eligible Martial Arts permits Dexterity and its class damage die. An eligible Open Hand Monk may select one additional technique for each Flurry hit; misses do not apply it.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: resolve_opportunity_attack

use_stunning_strike.description: Spend one Focus Point on a hit for Monk level 5 Stunning Strike, at most once this combat turn.

08229ad886ac23fb.description: Spend a Reaction to make one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike immediately before a visible creature leaves reach.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: resolve_srd_condition_saving_throw
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Roll a creature's saved ability modifier against a condition-causing source's DC; active timed defenses apply automatically. The caller still resolves the source's stated consequences.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: resolve_srd_control_activity
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Spend the actual task action, preserving activity until its completion is adjudicated.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: resolve_srd_control_order
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Perform prescribed movement through the admitted scene and shared movement budget.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: resolve_srd_fall
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Resolve one actual fall after the GM establishes its distance and landing surface. Roll 1d6 Bludgeoning per full 10 feet (maximum 20d6), apply shared defenses and HP consequences, and land Prone unless no damage is taken. Choose at most one Reaction; Slow Fall requires Monk level 4 and reduces damage by five times Monk level. A liquid landing permits a DC 15 Athletics or Acrobatics Reaction check to halve damage. Character modifiers are derived; NPC checks require saved skill totals from prepare_srd_creature or record_srd_creature_skill_checks. This records a fall, not movement or a voluntary action.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: resolve_srd_fear_turn
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Spend Fear's real Dash and scene movement, deriving source line of sight at the final position.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: resolve_srd_otherworldly_mount_balance
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Resolve the saved DC 10 Dexterity save after mounted Prone or before involuntary motion. Choose a clear off-mount position at the rider's actual height within five feet; a failed save opens the real fall.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: resolve_srd_scene_relation
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Calculate range, direction, sight and plane from admitted actor/target entries.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: resolve_srd_sight
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Resolve sight from declared scene facts and saved native/spell senses. For objects omit subject_state. Use a test only for a meaningful uncertain Perception check or a visual-illusion saving throw; the GM supplies fictional appearance and actual illusion content.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: resolve_srd_summon_breath
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Spend a summoned creature's saved Breath Weapon action and resolve one shared cone damage roll.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: resolve_unarmed_opportunity_attack

other_wielded_weapons.description: Actual weapon IDs currently wielded while making the Unarmed Strike, not everything carried. Supply every held weapon; empty means no weapon is wielded. The engine checks ownership and Monk weapon categories.

unarmed_damage_type.description: Choose Force only for a damaging Unarmed Strike with Monk level 6 Empowered Strikes. Grapple and Shove do not deal this damage.

use_stunning_strike.description: Spend one Focus Point on a hit for Monk level 5 Stunning Strike, at most once this combat turn.

08229ad886ac23fb.description: Resolve the bound Unarmed Opportunity Attack with the shared Damage, Grapple or Shove rules, spending only the Reaction.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: resolve_unarmed_strike

other_wielded_weapons.description: Actual weapon IDs currently wielded while making the Unarmed Strike, not everything carried. Supply every held weapon; empty means no weapon is wielded. The engine checks ownership and Monk weapon categories.

unarmed_damage_type.description: Choose Force only for a damaging Unarmed Strike with Monk level 6 Empowered Strikes. Grapple and Shove do not deal this damage.

use_stunning_strike.description: Spend one Focus Point on a hit for Monk level 5 Stunning Strike, at most once this combat turn.

08229ad886ac23fb.description: Resolve one Unarmed Strike against a creature entity within five feet. Choose Damage, Grapple, or Shove. Uses the character's Strength (or eligible Martial Arts Dexterity) and Proficiency and the target's authoritative size and chosen saving-throw modifier. An ordinary NPC needs no participant artifact. Each strike spends one attack from the Attack action.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: restore_srd_resource
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Restore a package-owned resource. For class Hit Dice, select hit_die_class for a partial change; restoring the full total restores every class pool.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: search_srd_action

finding_target.description: Actual creature this Wisdom Perception or Survival check attempts to find.

08229ad886ac23fb.description: Spend the creature's Action to make a Wisdom check using an official Search skill.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: set_srd_illumination_cover
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Record actual opaque covering of an admitted light-source object; covering does not quench Continual Flame. Outside combat, retained exploration objects use their local physical facts; no map setup or movement is required.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: set_srd_respiration
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Declare a creature's actual respiration medium and choking. The engine derives breath capacity from its saved Constitution or validated Character File, retains native air/water modes, and consumes Water Breathing at later time and turn boundaries.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: set_srd_rest_activity
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Change ordinary rest activity or resume an interrupted Long Rest. Sleep applies Unconscious and ends concentration; light activity is reading, talking, eating or watch. Exertion does not count as rest, interrupts a Short Rest immediately, and interrupts a Long Rest after an accumulated hour. Cancel abandons the rest. Advance actual elapsed time separately for all resting creatures together.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: shake_srd_sleeping_creature

target_distance.description: Current target distance in feet when not supplied by saved combat geometry. Supply the established scene distance; self-targeting is distance zero.

08229ad886ac23fb.description: Spend an actual action to shake away selected Sleep sources.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: speak_srd_truth_zone
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Speak with an admitted fiction classification; exact failed zones prevent deliberate lies only inside.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: spend_combat_movement

end_in_air.description: For flight, true if the creature remains aloft after this movement; false if it lands.

fear_source_in_sight.description: Actual visible fear source, used for a Difficult Terrain landing check.

running_start.description: For a jump, true only after moving at least 10 feet on foot immediately before this jump. Record that run-up as movement first.

08229ad886ac23fb.description: Spend a positive distance of normal or Difficult Terrain movement before or after the turn's action. Use this only when the active creature actually moves a declared distance; never use it to end a turn or discard unused movement. Call end_combat_turn for that instead. For a character’s unobstructed jump, choose long_jump or high_jump and declare the actual running start; the engine derives reach and spends each foot once. For long_jump, difficult_terrain means the landing requires its DC 10 Acrobatics check. Obstacle-clearance rulings are separate. For a Monk of level 9 or higher wearing no armor and wielding no Shield, choose vertical_surface or liquid_surface for Acrobatic Movement. This permits traversal only during this movement on the creature's turn; it does not grant flight, hovering, or the ability to remain unsupported after movement ends. The GM establishes the surface and endpoint from the scene. Active mobility spells also permit fly, climb, ceiling, liquid_surface, or spell_jump. Fly grants 60-foot flight and hovering; end_in_air records whether the creature remains aloft. Spider Climb uses current Speed on surfaces and ceilings with free hands. Jump spends 10 feet once per turn to jump up to 30 feet. Water Walk treats liquid as harmless solid ground while heat remains a separate hazard; use its transition action to enter it.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: spend_srd_bonus_action
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Spend the active creature's one Bonus Action on an option granted by its canonical artifact state.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: spend_srd_reaction
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Spend a creature's one Reaction on an option granted by its canonical artifact state.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: spend_srd_resource
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Spend a package-owned resource. For class Hit Dice, select hit_die_class for a partial change; restoring the full total restores every class pool. For Action Surge, call use_srd_action_surge instead: it also grants the action.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: stabilize_character
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Use the Help action to make the official DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check to stabilize a creature at 0 Hit Points.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: stabilize_srd_creature
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Take the Help action to attempt ordinary first aid on a living, unstable creature at 0 HP able to receive physical first aid. Use the helper's actual Wisdom (Medicine) modifier; the native DC 10 check determines stabilization. Stabilization grants no HP and leaves Unconscious until recovery. This operation does not consume a Healer's Kit or simulate a healing spell.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: start_group_combat_encounter

uncanny_metabolism_users.description: Monk combatants choosing Uncanny Metabolism when Initiative is rolled: regain all Focus and heal Monk level plus the Martial Arts die, once per Long Rest. Leave empty to decline; eligible level-15 Monks then receive Perfect Focus automatically.

08229ad886ac23fb.description:
Roll Initiative once for every living creature taking part in a group encounter. Supply all player characters, GM-controlled companions, and hostiles that are present when combat starts. The engine owns the resulting order; never omit a present companion merely to fit the two-creature encounter operation.
Coordinate combat requires a saved spatial scene. For the first encounter, supply one scene in combat_scenes using the spatial_scene format 1 content definition: format=1; map with id, revision, bounds.min/max (three coordinates), grid.cell_size/unit='ft'/origin (two coordinates), and layers (id/min_elevation/max_elevation); entities, geometry, zones and terrain arrays. Each combatant needs exactly one active creature body: id, map_id, position (three coordinates), footprint (box.half_extents or circle.radius), height, facing (two coordinates), active, movement, visibility, and metadata with participant_ref equal to its saved actor ID, creature_type, plane and lighting. Choose physical positions and body dimensions from the encounter fiction; do not invent a target-distance substitute. Include known blockers and terrain. Declare metadata.player.label/kind only on bodies and geometry the player knows. 
Coordinate combat uses the saved spatial scene. Supply one combat_scenes entry when admitting a later roster or an actual new arena. Omit it to reuse the scene. For the same map ID, keep the existing bounds, grid and layers: all saved bodies, objects, blockers, zones and terrain remain authoritative; supplied rows with existing IDs do not edit or relocate them. New IDs add genuinely present scene facts. For a new map ID, explicitly place every accompanying saved body/object by its exact ID. Existing dimensions, activity and mechanic metadata are retained; only actual destination position, facing, plane and ambient lighting are admitted. Include active summons, carried/worn objects, and a live Mage Hand with its cargo and caster. Arena replacement is unavailable while an anchored object, wall panel including permanent Stone, retained coordinate area/terrain or anchored light needs its current scene. Those effects are preserved and the operation clearly rejects before initiative; do not remove them or substitute a different map ID to bypass this limit. Exploration does not require map movement.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: study_srd_action
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Spend the creature's Action to make an Intelligence check using an official Study skill.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: take_disengage_action
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Spend the turn's action so the creature's movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks for the rest of this turn.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: take_dodge_action
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Spend the turn's action to impose attack Disadvantage and gain Dexterity-save Advantage until the start of the creature's next turn.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: take_srd_otherworldly_steed_action
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Take Dash, Disengage or Dodge with the actual Otherworldly Steed's native Action budget. Enter its controlled phase first while the capable caster rides; an independent Steed uses its own active turn.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: take_srd_short_rest_hit_die
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Immediately after a tracked Short Rest completes, spend one Hit Die and apply its healing. Choose further dice after each result, before advancing time or resuming other activity. For mixed class pools, ask which class's die to spend and supply hit_die_class. Omit it for older single-die characters or a single class pool.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: transfer_srd_attack_mark
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Move a genuine earned curse or quarry mark with one later Bonus Action.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: traverse_srd_tree_stride
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Traverse living same-kind trees using Tree Stride's actual range, size, turn limit and movement costs.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: trigger_opportunity_attack

other_wielded_weapons.description: Actual other weapon IDs wielded alongside the selected weapon, not everything carried. Supply every other held weapon; empty means none.

08229ad886ac23fb.description: Bind a visible leave-reach trigger. For characters select an owned melee weapon, ability and actual grip; attack and damage are derived from saved character data. Raw attack fields are used only for an NPC stat-block attack. Select weapon unarmed_strike for a character Unarmed Strike, then use resolve_unarmed_opportunity_attack.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: unbound_d20_test
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Resolve an SRD 5.2.1 D20 Test without a campaign participant. Supply the explicit ability modifier, proficiency bonus, proficiency factor, target number, and situational judgments.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: use_monk_focus_action
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Use Monk’s Focus as one Bonus Action, preserving the normal Action. Patient Defense grants Disengage, plus Dodge for one Focus. Step of the Wind grants Dash, plus Disengage and doubled jump distance this turn for one Focus. At Monk 10 a paid Patient Defense also rolls temporary HP; paid Step may carry one willing nearby Large-or-smaller creature. Fixed benefits derive from saved class data. Supply actual proximity and willingness; no armor restriction applies to these Focus features.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: use_monk_wholeness_of_body
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Spend one Wholeness of Body use to heal an Open Hand Monk with the earned Martial Arts die plus Wisdom (minimum 1). In combat this spends the Bonus Action; all uses recover only on a Long Rest.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: use_srd_action_surge
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Use a Fighter's Action Surge on their active turn, before or after their ordinary action. Atomically spend one charge and grant one additional action, except Magic. This costs no action, Bonus Action or movement and is limited to once per turn. Follow with the intended action; spending a resource alone does not use this feature.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: use_srd_dragon_breath
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Use the recipient's actual retained Dragon's Breath Magic action.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: use_srd_native_mummy_glare
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Use the printed standalone Glare action on this Mummy's actual commanded turn.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: use_srd_native_wight_life_drain
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Use native Life Drain alone or replace one actual Multiattack weapon use.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: use_srd_second_wind
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Use one Second Wind charge for a living Fighter and restore Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus Fighter level. In combat this atomically spends the active creature's granted Second Wind Bonus Action. The charge is spent even at full Hit Points.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: use_srd_steed_fell_glare
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Use the Fiend Otherworldly Steed's Fell Glare, recharging after its Long Rest. Outside combat, supply current established_target_distance in feet and established_same_plane=true; these are current fictional facts, never birth placement or a cached map position. Combat still qualifies the actual admitted bodies. Fell Glare also requires established_target_visible=true.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: use_srd_steed_fey_step
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Use the Fey Otherworldly Steed's Fey Step, recharging after its Long Rest. Outside combat, supply the current established_destination description, established_distance in feet, established_plane, established_same_plane=true and established_space_unoccupied=true for the full Steed and its genuine saved rider. This records fiction, never coordinates. Explicitly supply established_environment_source_ids=[] when no environmental source currently interacts with this teleport; relevant unresolved source interactions reject. At combat entry explicitly admit these same Steed/rider IDs at their actual current placements.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: use_srd_steed_healing_touch
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Use the Celestial Otherworldly Steed's Healing Touch, recharging after its Long Rest. Outside combat, supply current established_target_distance in feet and established_same_plane=true; these are current fictional facts, never birth placement or a cached map position. Combat still qualifies the actual admitted bodies.

08229ad886ac23fb.name: violate_srd_geas
08229ad886ac23fb.description: Apply Geas's real Psychic damage at most once per source on each lasting-clock day.

57e1763b2c7b339e.name: begin_srd_spell_action
57e1763b2c7b339e.description:
In combat, begin a source-validated casting action before its spell resolves. Outside combat, cast with cast_spell_outside_combat instead.
For Web, Cloud of Daggers, Insect Plague, Stinking Cloud, Fog Cloud, Sleet Storm or Zone of Truth, set known_area=true only when the player knows the committed spell area from observing the cast or another established fact. Omitted or false means hidden on the combat map. This fact does not reveal its caster or any creature, authorize movement, or change spell mechanics. In combat, Flame Strike requires environment_origin as its chosen Cylinder point; saved positions determine recipients, range and cover. In combat, Fear uses the saved body facing or instant_area_direction/apex for its Cone; Sleep chooses environment_origin for its Sphere. Saved positions determine actual recipients, range, plane and clear paths. For Misty Step outside combat, supply exactly one established destination fact record: its named place, actual current_plane and destination plane, horizontal_distance_feet, signed elevation_change_feet (negative means downward), visible and unoccupied. Do not invent these facts; the destination must be on the current plane and within the original 30-foot straight-line range, including either upward or downward elevation. Combat ignores this record and uses travel_destination and the saved scene.
Outside combat, Find Steed and Summon Dragon use established fictional placement. Supply created_actor_placement (a short established location), created_actor_distance in feet, created_actor_space_unoccupied=true and created_actor_clear_path=true. Summon Dragon also requires created_actor_space_visible=true; Find Steed does not. These facts do not create coordinates. The paid creature keeps its exact saved ID and source statistics. At later combat entry, explicitly include its same ID, printed Large box footprint, actual height/position/plane/ambient lighting and source metadata in combat_scenes. Combat movement, mounting and attacks use that admitted body. Exploration Steed abilities and mounting use current fiction as described by their tools. Combat casting still uses the authoritative scene and its actual placement/sight checks.
Outside combat, when this spell heals a caster with an active Otherworldly Steed, first call establish_srd_lite_steed_healing_proximity with that exact caster and Steed, their current established nearest separation in feet, and whether they currently share a plane. This fact authorizes one healing qualification at the current lasting tick; establish it immediately before the healing event. Birth placement is never current proximity. Combat Life Bond always measures the admitted actual bodies. Outside combat, Mage Hand uses current fictional placement, nearest caster separation and actual clear-path/contact facts, including its cargo and shared plane. No combat turn or map is required. A later Magic action advances ordinary time by one round; the hand moves at most 30 feet and vanishes beyond 30 feet from its caster. Outside combat, Thaumaturgy uses current established origin_distance, origin_has_clear_path and minor_same_plane facts for remote wonders, flames and doors/windows, even when an old combat map is saved. Use the exact admitted minor_object_id and existing subject/access/flame facts. Altered Eyes and Booming Voice affect the actual caster. No exploration coordinates are inferred. In combat, known_area=true also displays a qualified pending area while its casting reaction window is open. Set it only when the player knows the actual chosen area, including any relocated origin. The preview does not reveal creatures, determine affected targets, spend a slot, or resolve the spell. Cone and Line displays show their exact XY footprint, clipped at map bounds; height still affects actual recipients.
For the offered spell bodies, Stone/Fire walls, Aura of Life and magical light, set known_spell_effect=true only for this cast's effect or created body whose presence and placement the player knows from a visible cast or an established current fact. It presents that effect, never a hidden caster, target, scouting eye or unrelated source. Omitted/false keeps private effects private. Range extents do not establish recipients, illumination, damage or safe movement.

Combat ignores this record and uses travel_destination and the saved scene.

Combat casting still uses the authoritative scene and its actual placement/sight checks.

This fact authorizes one healing qualification at the current lasting tick; establish it immediately before the healing event. Birth placement is never current proximity. Combat Life Bond always measures the admitted actual bodies. A later Magic action advances ordinary time by one round; the hand moves at most 30 feet and vanishes beyond 30 feet from its caster. Outside combat, Thaumaturgy uses current established origin_distance, origin_has_clear_path and minor_same_plane facts for remote wonders, flames and doors/windows, even when an old combat map is saved. Use the exact admitted minor_object_id and existing subject/access/flame facts. Altered Eyes and Booming Voice affect the actual caster. No exploration coordinates are inferred.
For the offered spell bodies, Stone/Fire walls, Aura of Life and magical light, set known_spell_effect=true only for this cast's effect or created body whose presence and placement the player knows from a visible cast or an established current fact. It presents that effect, never a hidden caster, target, scouting eye or unrelated source. Omitted/false keeps private effects private. Range extents do not establish recipients, illumination, damage or safe movement.

area_object_targets.description: Actual scenery selected by the GM as lying in the spell's area.

caster.description: Validated character ID for a Player Character or Companion; omit for a prepared NPC.

caster_can_touch_target.description: For a Touch spell on another creature without engine-derived combat range, supply true only when the caster can touch that target now; false means it is out of touch reach. Self-touch is automatic.

contingent_fact_tag.description: A selected narrative occurrence tag; mechanical HP/save/hit/condition outcomes use native events.

fire_bolt_object_facts.description: Outside combat, establish one actual Fire Bolt object receiver's current place, caster/current and object planes, distance, sight, categorical Cover and whether a nonincapacitated enemy within five feet can see the caster. Admit the actual object and classify its native material/size/durability; record combustibility and ordinary fuel facts before casting. Combat ignores these fictional facts.

fire_storm_cubes.description: Fire Storm only: each aligned 10-foot cube has min [x,y,z], origin [x,y,z] on a face, and include_origin. Set origin_unseen true for an unseen point; a blocked origin forms on the near side of the first solid obstruction, translating that cube. Actual scene recipients and ignition are derived before payment. For Cover that varies by cube origin, admit target scene metadata.cover_from_points rows with point [x,y,z], plane, and cover (none, half, three_quarters, or total).

healing_allocations.description: For a fixed healing pool, HP amounts assigned in the same order as targets; the engine checks their sum.

ice_storm_ground_zone_ids.description: Actual ground zones the GM identifies as affected by Ice Storm's Cylinder.

instant_area_height.description: In combat, declare the Line vertical extent from the scene. SRD fixes its length and width but gives no height; 0 is unspecified.

instant_area_include_origin.description: Choose whether the Cone or Line includes its origin.

material_component_available.description: For a required Material component, confirm the selected supply can be accessed with a hand or used as its focus description allows.

material_item_ids.description: Saved spell_materials supply IDs to use. Actual carried inventory, unit quantities, value, component compatibility and focus permission are checked. Never substitute a pouch/focus for priced or consumed material.

shatter_object_targets.description: Actual objects the GM identifies as lying in Shatter's ten-foot Sphere.

sleepless_targets.description: Selected Sleep targets whose admitted creature/species traits say they do not sleep.

slot_resource.description: Required for characters. Use feature for a saved source's free cast at the spell's base level. Omit for NPCs, whose casting level and uses come from their saved stat block.

somatic_component_available.description: Defaults to true. Held weapons, shields and other items never prevent spell gestures, in or out of combat. Set false only when the scene prevents the caster from moving enough to gesture.

spell_grant.description: Choose the saved source when more than one class, feat or lineage grants this spell.

summon_distance.description: Distance from the caster to the creature's unoccupied space in feet.

summon_id.description: New persistent entity ID for a spell-created creature.

target_distance.description: Current target distance in feet when not supplied by saved combat geometry. Supply the established scene distance; self-targeting is distance zero.

thunderwave_unsecured_objects.description: Actual unsecured objects the GM identifies as entirely inside the Cube.

travel_exploration_destinations.description: For Misty Step outside combat, supply exactly one established destination fact record: its named place, actual current_plane and destination plane, horizontal_distance_feet, signed elevation_change_feet (negative means downward), visible and unoccupied. Do not invent these facts; the destination must be on the current plane and within the original 30-foot straight-line range, including either upward or downward elevation. Combat ignores this record and uses travel_destination and the saved scene.

true_strike_weapon.description: Choose only a weapon established in the active actor's authoritative inventory. Use the canonical singular weapon ID; an inventory entry of darts authorizes dart.

verbal_component_available.description: Required for a spell with a Verbal component unless the saved NPC stat block waives it. True only if the caster can speak normally and is not gagged or in magical silence.

armor_class.description: AC from the source or explicit GM adjudication.

cantrip_scaling_level.description: Default 1. Supply another level only when the stat block explicitly grants scaled cantrips; never substitute Challenge Rating.

challenge_rating_eighths.description: The stat block's Challenge Rating multiplied by eight. Omit when unknown; transformation eligibility then cannot be asserted from this creature state.

charisma_save.description: Optional signed charisma saving-throw modifier. Supply the source value or explicitly adjudicate it; omission does not establish a zero modifier.

constitution_save.description: Optional signed constitution saving-throw modifier. Supply the source value or explicitly adjudicate it; omission does not establish a zero modifier.

creature_id.description: Stable unique ID for this individual creature, at most 128 letters/digits or . _ : -. Reuse it later; never use a Player Character or Companion ID.

creature_type.description: Creature type from the selected stat block. Omit when unknown; type-qualified spell effects cannot infer it.

damage_immunities.description: Copy all damage immunities from the source; an omitted list means none.

damage_resistances.description: Copy all damage resistances from the source; an omitted list means none.

damage_vulnerabilities.description: Copy all damage vulnerabilities from the source; an omitted list means none.

dexterity_save.description: Optional signed dexterity saving-throw modifier. Supply the source value or explicitly adjudicate it; omission does not establish a zero modifier.

equipment.description: Optional one equipment profile from the stat block or recorded GM adaptation. Record base speeds before armor, AC without worn gear (including natural defenses), Strength/Dexterity, armor training, and zero or one carried item in armor/shield. Supplied final AC and walking Speed must agree. Omit only when gear changes are not needed.

flying_speed.description: Copy actual native Flying Speed from the source; zero if none.

hit_points.description: Current and maximum HP for this newly introduced, unwounded creature. Never prepare an existing wounded creature again.

initiative_modifier.description: Signed Initiative modifier from the source or explicit GM adjudication.

intelligence_save.description: Optional signed intelligence saving-throw modifier. Supply the source value or explicitly adjudicate it; omission does not establish a zero modifier.

multiattack.description: Optional pure-attack Multiattack routine from the read stat block or explicit recorded adaptation. Each attack name is unique, at most 120 characters, and names one component with its permitted count. This does not encode spell substitutions or other non-attack effects.

proficiency_bonus.description: Actual stat-block Proficiency Bonus when a spell-created creature inherits it.

saving_throw_proficiencies.description: Copy the explicit complete proficiency list from the source. Omission leaves training unknown; an empty list explicitly records none.

size_rank.description: Size from the source or recorded adjudication: Tiny 0, Small 1, Medium 2, Large 3, Huge 4, Gargantuan 5.

skill_checks.description: Actual total NPC skill-check modifiers from the selected stat block. For an unlisted skill use its actual ability modifier. Omitted skills remain unknown; never guess them from saving throws.

skill_proficiencies.description: Copy the explicit complete proficiency list from the source. Omission leaves training unknown; an empty list explicitly records none.

source.description: 1 to 1000 characters: identify the read Plan/Setting/stat-block reference and explicitly explain any GM-adjudicated adaptation or missing statistics.

speed.description: Walking speed in feet from the source or explicit GM adjudication.

spell_component_exemptions.description: Copy only components explicitly waived by this creature stat block. Empty means normal spell components are required; do not infer a waiver from slot-free casting.

spells.description: Executable spells from the stat block. Each has its own X/day pool; 0 means at will. Omit casting_level for its lowest level. Set it only for an explicit stat-block exception; shared pools and other restrictions are not encoded by this list.

strength_save.description: Optional signed strength saving-throw modifier. Supply the source value or explicitly adjudicate it; omission does not establish a zero modifier.

wisdom_save.description: Optional signed wisdom saving-throw modifier. Supply the source value or explicitly adjudicate it; omission does not establish a zero modifier.

state_change.description: After you compare the complete response with pre-action Campaign State, declare whether any durable truth changed. Use 'changed' when any supplied collection records new post-action truth, otherwise use 'unchanged'.

state_change_summary.description: Brief private accounting of what durably changed, or why the response leaves Campaign State exactly unchanged. This assessment is audited but is not itself stored as campaign truth. Maximum 1000 characters, including spaces and newlines. Aim for one or two short sentences well below the maximum; put full facts in their own records instead of repeating them here.

entity_id.description: Stable campaign identity. Reuse it when the same person, place, creature, or object changes later.

entity_kind.description: Plain entity kind, such as person, place, creature, or object.

name.description: Current name, 1-300 characters, appropriate to this record's visibility. An unrevealed true name from Plan or Setting preparation belongs in a gm_private entity record, not a player_known one.

attributes.description: Current campaign-specific facts, such as location, condition, allegiance, or status. Include the complete current values that should remain true. For a player character, never infer posture, alertness, equipment use, or another action from inventory alone.

visibility.description: Knowledge boundary for the entire entity record, including its name and attributes. Use player_known only when every included detail has been established for the player; otherwise use gm_private.

known_by.description: Exact identities that have actually learned this entity state in the fiction. Do not include the player merely because the GM knows it or plans a future reveal.

source_ref.description: Optional admitted Setting or participant source path for this identity. Omit when there is no admitted source; never send an empty string.

entities.description: Every change of this kind established by the current GM response. Omit this collection when none changed.

fact_id.description: A stable identifier for this lasting campaign fact. Reuse it when a plan is completed, an obligation fulfilled, or this truth corrected. Write the complete current truth, including the outcome; earlier versions remain in history. If separate records already describe the old plan and its outcome, update the old plan record to say it is completed or superseded instead of leaving it as a current instruction.

category.description: The kind of lasting fact established by play.

text.description: The concise campaign-specific truth to remember (1-2000 characters). Keep separate lasting facts in separate records.

visibility.description: Knowledge boundary for the entire fact as written. Use player_known only when released play, player-authored text, or prior player-known Campaign State establishes every detail; otherwise use gm_private.

known_by.description: Exact identities that have actually learned this truth in the fiction. Do not include the player merely because the GM knows it or plans a future reveal.

subjects.description: Optional stable entity identifiers this fact is about.

facts.description: Every change of this kind established by the current GM response. Omit this collection when none changed.

summary.description: The concise current scene situation established by play (1-2000 characters). Never add a player action or equipment posture that player text, the participant artifact, or existing Campaign State did not establish.

act_id.description: Optional Campaign Plan preparation item associated with what play reached.

scenes.description: Every change of this kind established by the current GM response. Omit this collection when none changed.

secret_id.description: An established secret currently eligible to be revealed.

audience.description: Exact identities that learned the secret in play.

reveals.description: Every change of this kind established by the current GM response. Omit this collection when none changed.

plan_item_id.description: Exact private Campaign Plan item identity from the current choices record.

progress_status.description: What play has actually done with this prepared item, never what the Plan hoped would happen. 'Introduced' means the GM made it available while the player's response remains unresolved; 'engaged' requires a player choice that interacts with it; 'deferred' means the player clearly declined, avoided, or left the introduced material behind. Deferred material remains possible but is not a current obligation. 'Resolved' means play has met all authored completion conditions and the closing event, including an explicitly allowed failure outcome. An act requires all of its linked objectives; side work cannot replace them. 'Retired' means play has made the item inapplicable, not that the act was completed. For ending:<id>, read the final act/structured/ending and resolve only after required acts/objectives and the selected immediate aftermath. This opens the player's continue/finish card; leave the after-story for their explicit Finish choice. Plan Progress is a bookmark, not a turn log: omit it when the status and practical meaning have not changed.

progress_summary.description: Short private reason, 1-2000 characters, grounded only in what play established. Describe what was offered or changed, and record an express player choice when it changes the status. Refresh a superseded summary when the outcome, evidence, or remaining obligation changes even if the status stays engaged. Do not rewrite an existing summary merely to mention the current turn when its status and practical meaning are unchanged. Otherwise leave the player's response unresolved. Never infer the player's interest, intent, acceptance, route, or next action. Do not describe the player as weighing, considering, interested in, or drawn to an option unless player text establishes it; use neutral no-choice-yet wording instead.

plan_progress.description: Every change of this kind established by the current GM response. Omit this collection when none changed.

character_updates.description: Every change of this kind established by the current GM response. Omit this collection when none changed.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: ability_check
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Resolve an identified character's ability check without a skill, using a tool, or using a different ability with a skill when the situation warrants it. Name one of the six abilities and any applicable skill/tool. The engine derives ability and ordinary proficiency modifiers from the saved character. Relevant skill and tool proficiency together grant Advantage, never a second proficiency bonus. Use only for uncertain outcomes that matter. Use dedicated Hide, Search, Study, Influence or combat operations when their rules apply. This operation does not infer class features such as Expertise; adjudicate their documented effects explicitly.

finding_target.description: Actual creature this Wisdom Perception or Survival check attempts to find.

interaction_target.description: Creature this Charisma check socially interacts with; saved Charm Advantage is derived automatically.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: activate_srd_weapon_set
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Switch a prepared weapon set freely on this creature's own turn. Switching never restores an Action, attack, Light/Nick use or other resource.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: admit_srd_native_wight_rise_language
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Admit the future Zombie's printed other understood language, not rise eligibility.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: advance_combat_encounter_turn
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Engine-owned non-choice transition that advances the persisted Initiative order and begins the next round when needed; if the other creature was defeated, it ends the encounter instead of assigning a dead current actor. The Ruleset binds the encounter creatures from authoritative combat state.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: advance_group_combat_encounter_turn
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Engine-owned non-choice transition through an arbitrary persisted Initiative order. It skips defeated creatures and advances the round when the order wraps. The Ruleset binds the completed creature from authoritative combat state.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: advance_srd_lasting_time
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Advance the bounded package-owned lasting-effect clock outside an encounter.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: advance_stable_recovery
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Advance the official 1d4-hour recovery clock for a Stable creature at 0 Hit Points.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: ask_srd_divination_question
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Ask within the source-owned question count and actual one-minute interval; the GM supplies the source-authorized answer.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: attack_srd_altered_natural_weapon
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Attack with the active Alter Self growth using saved proficiency and caster modifier.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: attack_srd_transformed_form
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Use one actual named Beast-form attack and its source-owned numbers and anatomy.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: award_srd_advancement
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record a Plan milestone or allocated XP award once for this character. Read the policy and verify its trigger, timing and recipients first. Repeat for every eligible party member when the policy awards the whole party. An award does not apply a level or resolve player choices.

award_id.description: Stable milestone ID, or unique XP event ID.

character_state.description: The same character ID, selecting its live mechanical state.

evidence.description: Played event satisfying the policy, including allocation.

xp.description: Allocated XP for this character; 0 for milestones.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: begin_combat_turn
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Engine-owned non-choice transition that initializes the exact current Initiative creature's official Speed and one-action budget. The Ruleset binds that creature from authoritative combat state.

hound_bite_choices.description: Optional Hound target intent; actual enemies, range and Cover are derived.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: begin_srd_after_hit_smite
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Reserve an after-hit spell Bonus Action on this saved final weapon hit.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: begin_srd_character_attack
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Reserve the attack cost, resolve targeting, then retain its real roll for reactions.

attack_ability.description: Match the selected weapon. A dart uses Dexterity and a quarterstaff uses Strength. Other finesse weapons permit either, ordinary melee or thrown weapons use Strength, and ordinary ranged weapons use Dexterity.

attack_mode.description: Match the selected weapon's legal use. A dart uses thrown, never melee; a quarterstaff uses melee. Use ranged only for a ranged weapon that is not being thrown.

other_wielded_weapons.description: Actual other weapon IDs wielded alongside the selected weapon, not everything carried. Supply every other held weapon; empty means none.

use_stunning_strike.description: Spend one Focus Point on a hit for Monk level 5 Stunning Strike, at most once this combat turn.

weapon.description: Omit for the clear active main-hand weapon. An explicit weapon must belong to the active prepared set. Ask the player to select an unresolved set rather than substitute another carried weapon.

wielding_two_handed.description: Saved equipped weapons determine actual hands; this legacy input cannot override an active prepared set.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: begin_srd_controlled_steed_phase
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Let the controlled Otherworldly Steed act on its actual riding caster's turn. Use Dash, Disengage or Dodge for its Action; its own Bonus Action stays separate. Pause this phase to resume the rider, then re-enter without refreshing spent budgets.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: begin_srd_creature_attack
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Reserve the attack cost, resolve targeting, then retain its real roll for reactions.

attack_distance.description: Actual distance to this target in feet.

attack_modifier.description: Signed d20 attack modifier from the admitted creature stat block or GM adaptation.

attack_name.description: Plain attack label from the admitted creature stat block or the GM's stated adaptation.

damage_expression.description: Damage dice only; select one exact enum value and do not include a modifier.

damage_modifier.description: Signed flat damage modifier applied after the damage dice.

long_range.description: Maximum ranged distance; for melee use the same value as normal_range.

normal_range.description: Melee reach or normal ranged distance in feet from the stat block or stated adaptation.

target.description: Exact authoritative entity ID of the living attack target; do not use its display name.

use_multiattack.description: Use a remaining named component of the creature's prepared Multiattack; true on every attack in that routine.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: begin_srd_extended_spell_action
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Perform this longer casting or Ritual action, then leave its actual Counterspell window open. Complete the saved window before further casting progress.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: begin_srd_otherworldly_forced_movement
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Begin a declared involuntary movement of the actual mounted Otherworldly Steed. The DC 10 rider Dexterity save must resolve before motion; this spends no voluntary movement.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: begin_srd_rest
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Start a tracked Short or Long Rest at the current campaign time. Long Rests need eight hours including six hours asleep and at most two of light activity; after finishing one, wait sixteen hours before starting another. Use set_srd_rest_activity to change activity, resume interruptions or abandon it, and advance_srd_lasting_time once for elapsed time shared by the party.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: begin_srd_scene_fall
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Open a Feather Fall Reaction window for actual airborne scene creatures.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: begin_srd_spell_cast
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Begin a source-defined longer casting or Ritual. Continue its Magic action each combat turn, or account for uninterrupted exploration rounds; then finish using cast_spell with current target facts. A failed Slow gesture spends the casting costs immediately.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: cast_srd_reaction_spell
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Cast a prepared Reaction spell against an actual saved trigger.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: change_srd_character_shield
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Equip or remove a carried shield through the existing armor authority and its ordinary combat cost.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: change_srd_equipment
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Don or doff one carried armor or shield. Empty item removes the worn item; one item equips it. Remove an existing item before replacing it. Use established item type and magic bonus, never invent equipment. Armor uses its SRD don/doff minutes outside combat; a shield uses a Utilize action in combat or one round outside combat.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: change_srd_transformation
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend one Magic action to change the original eligible form or selected Animal Shapes subjects.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: check_srd_native_wight_ability
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Resolve this actual Wight's native ability check from saved source statistics.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: choose_srd_chromatic_orb_leap
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Choose or decline Chromatic Orb's earned leap in its original paid casting.

target_distance.description: Current target distance in feet when not supplied by saved combat geometry. Supply the established scene distance; self-targeting is distance zero.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: collect_srd_irresistible_dance
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend a real action and repeat the active Dance source's Wisdom save to collect yourself.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: command_srd_summoned_creature
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Give an active summoned creature a verbal command without spending the caster's action.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: communicate_srd_spell
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Consume spell-enabled communication and source-bounded information eligibility.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: complete_srd_coordinate_movement
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Continue the saved remaining destination or explicitly stop after the committed movement prefix.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: complete_srd_pending_action
dc533c6bc4229191.description:
Complete the saved action after its reaction window without another roll or cost.
Outside combat, when this spell heals a caster with an active Otherworldly Steed, first call establish_srd_lite_steed_healing_proximity with that exact caster and Steed, their current established nearest separation in feet, and whether they currently share a plane. This fact authorizes one healing qualification at the current lasting tick; establish it immediately before the healing event. Birth placement is never current proximity. Combat Life Bond always measures the admitted actual bodies.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: complete_srd_rest
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Complete a tracked rest after the clock and activity requirements are met. Restore encoded class resources or NPC per-day spells; a Long Rest also restores HP and Hit Dice, removes ordinary Temporary HP and reduces recoverable Exhaustion. Short Rest Hit Dice remain a separate player choice. Missing resource maxima are never invented.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: continue_srd_extended_spell_action
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Perform this longer casting or Ritual action, then leave its actual Counterspell window open. Complete the saved window before further casting progress.

somatic_component_available.description: Defaults to true. Held weapons, shields and other items never prevent spell gestures, in or out of combat. Set false only when the scene prevents the caster from moving enough to gesture.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: continue_srd_spell_cast
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend the next casting Magic action, or advance uninterrupted exploration rounds. Casting fails if concentration breaks or a required combat turn is missed.

somatic_component_available.description: Defaults to true. Held weapons, shields and other items never prevent spell gestures, in or out of combat. Set false only when the scene prevents the caster from moving enough to gesture.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: control_srd_mage_hand
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend the actual later Magic action to move and manipulate the saved spectral hand. Outside combat, Mage Hand uses current fictional placement, nearest caster separation and actual clear-path/contact facts, including its cargo and shared plane. No combat turn or map is required. A later Magic action advances ordinary time by one round; the hand moves at most 30 feet and vanishes beyond 30 feet from its caster.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: d20_test
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Resolve an SRD 5.2.1 skill check for a campaign character. Choose the participant, skill, target number, circumstantial modifier, sensory requirements, and applicable advantage or disadvantage. Sylvia derives the entity state, ability, and proficiency from authority. Call this only when success or failure is genuinely uncertain and matters to play. Routine description of immediately obvious surroundings needs no check; a general look around is not by itself a Perception check. Use Perception when detecting something concealed or otherwise uncertain would produce a meaningful different outcome. Never substitute this skill check for a weapon attack, spell attack, or other mechanic with its own exposed operation. Use ability_check for a check without a skill, with a tool, or with a situationally appropriate different ability.

finding_target.description: Actual creature this Wisdom Perception or Survival check attempts to find.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: dash_combat_action
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend the turn's action to gain extra ordinary movement equal to effective Speed.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: death_saving_throw
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Resolve one SRD 5.2.1 Death Saving Throw for a living, unstable character at 0 Hit Points. Recovery leaves the turn available; otherwise close it through the shared End Turn effects.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: dismiss_srd_divination_spell
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Dismiss one exact source-owned time-span spell without an action.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: dismiss_srd_etherealness
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Dismiss this caster's ongoing Etherealness with no action under SRD time-span rules.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: dismiss_srd_illumination_spell
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Dismiss this caster's selected illumination effect, preserving every independent source.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: dismiss_srd_information_spell
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Dismiss this caster's information spell without an action.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: dismiss_srd_senses_spell
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Dismiss only this caster's saved time-span senses spell without spending an action. An Incapacitated caster cannot dismiss it. Native senses and other casters' grants remain active.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: dismiss_srd_spell
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Dismiss one selected actual ongoing time-span cast without spending an action. Its cast ID comes from the casting result; legacy records without that identity cannot be grouped by caster, spell, or tick.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: dismount_srd_otherworldly_steed
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Dismount the actual Otherworldly Steed to an unoccupied supported space within five feet. Outside combat, supply the actual current mount_placement, mount_current_plane, mount_same_plane=true, nearest mount_distance_feet within five feet, mount_clear_path=true and mount_space_unoccupied=true. For dismounting, also name dismount_placement and establish dismount_ground_supported=true. These current fictional facts do not create coordinates or an exploration movement budget. The rider must still be able to spend half their current Speed. Combat continues to use saved bodies, actual supporting ground and the original movement payment. If Spirit Guardians is active in the world, supply the current established mount_guardian_speed_halved fact for this exact rider; an unrelated source does not halve the rider's Speed.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: disperse_srd_fog
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Disperse an actual fog source using a strong-wind zone admitted to the scene.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: end_combat_encounter
dc533c6bc4229191.description: End the encounter when one side is defeated or fighting has actually stopped, including surrender or an agreed sparring win condition. This atomically closes an active turn and releases any declared combat action that no longer applies; do not perform that action merely to satisfy turn order. Preserve committed damage, rolls and spent resources.

self_restoration.description: For a Monk of level 10 or higher, choose one condition to remove at the end of this turn. This is optional and does not spend an action.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: end_combat_turn
dc533c6bc4229191.description: When the player says the active creature ends its turn, call this immediately even if movement remains. The actor is bound automatically; optionally select one eligible Self-Restoration condition. Also call it after the active creature has otherwise finished acting, before handing play to another Initiative creature. It closes the package-owned action and movement budget; never substitute spend_combat_movement merely to discard unused movement, and never describe another turn as begun until the engine commits the later lifecycle transitions. The Ruleset binds the active creature from authoritative combat state.

celestial_light_choices.description: Optional source caster choices for this actual creature ending its turn; membership, visibility and once-per-turn eligibility are derived.

self_restoration.description: For a Monk of level 10 or higher, choose one condition to remove at the end of this turn. This is optional and does not spend an action.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: end_concentration
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Voluntarily end the selected creature's current package-owned concentration without spending an action.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: escape_srd_grapple_action
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend the active Grappled creature's Action to attempt the official Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) escape check against the stored escape DC.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: escape_srd_nonmagical_restraint
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend five feet of movement to escape a saved nonmagical restraint or Grapple under Freedom of Movement.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: escape_srd_web
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend an Action on the source DC Strength (Athletics) check to escape Web.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: establish_srd_lite_steed_healing_proximity
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Establish this owned active Steed's current fictional proximity for one imminent spell healing event. Use current nearest separation, including vertical separation, and actual shared-plane knowledge; never reuse birth distance. This is a fact declaration, not movement or healing.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: finish_srd_monster_turn
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Automatically finish a monster turn after its action and attacks are exhausted. The engine supplies the active actor; no model choice is required.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: help_srd_ability_check_action
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend the creature's Action to Help an ally's next check with one of the helper's skill or tool proficiencies.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: help_srd_attack_action
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend the creature's Action to Help an ally's next attack against a nearby target.

target_distance.description: Current target distance in feet when not supplied by saved combat geometry. Supply the established scene distance; self-targeting is distance zero.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: hide_srd_action
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend the creature's Action to attempt the official DC 15 Dexterity (Stealth) Hide check.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: influence_srd_action
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend the creature's Action to make the appropriate Wisdom or Charisma check using an official Influence skill.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: inspect_srd_minor_world_effects
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Read actual active minor world sources affecting an object or actual caster.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: level_up_srd_character
dc533c6bc4229191.description:
Apply one earned or queued starting SRD level. Read the retained class level, subclass, feat and spell rules; resolve every player choice before proposing the build. Provide complete proficiency lists preserving existing grants and all new features. The player confirms the proposal. Feature records are not automatic feature execution.
Selected spell headers restrict eligible choices. Full complete-grant and earned-level requirements remain unchanged; initial character validation describes available choices and reports current repertoire shortfalls. Pending profiles cannot fill missing choices. Gameplay verification remains pending. Supply resulting AC and walking Speed; the engine validates both against new class features and worn equipment while retaining base species Speed.

build.description: Complete resulting build. Resulting walking Speed after the new class features and worn equipment. The engine derives it from the retained base species Speed; do not change that base.

character_state.description: The same character ID, selecting its live mechanical state.

choices_summary.description: Explain all gains and choices to the player; at most 1000 characters.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: mount_srd_otherworldly_steed
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Mount the actual willing Otherworldly Steed, spending half the rider's current Speed. Outside combat, supply the actual current mount_placement, mount_current_plane, mount_same_plane=true, nearest mount_distance_feet within five feet, mount_clear_path=true and mount_space_unoccupied=true. For dismounting, also name dismount_placement and establish dismount_ground_supported=true. These current fictional facts do not create coordinates or an exploration movement budget. The rider must still be able to spend half their current Speed. Combat continues to use saved bodies, actual supporting ground and the original movement payment. If Spirit Guardians is active in the world, supply the current established mount_guardian_speed_halved fact for this exact rider; an unrelated source does not halve the rider's Speed.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: move_srd_scene_creature
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Combat only. Follow a legal creature-space route and consume its actual movement cost.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: observe_srd_information_proxy
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Observe an active invisible sensor with actual observer senses and scene obstruction.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: operate_srd_information_proxy
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Move Arcane Eye or switch Clairvoyance's sense using its actual Bonus Action.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: pause_srd_controlled_steed_phase
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Pause the controlled Steed and resume its rider's existing turn budget. The Steed can resume later on this rider turn with the movement and actions it has left.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: prepare_srd_coordinate_opportunity
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Choose this saved movement's actual reacting creature and delegate to the unchanged native trigger. Declining spends no Reaction; completion preserves the remaining destination.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: prepare_srd_creature
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Prepare one new NPC or monster from a read Plan/Setting stat block, or an explicitly recorded GM adjudication, before starting combat. This creates authoritative creature state; narrative characters do not create it. Use one stable ID per individual. Existing identities and Player Characters/Companions are rejected without resetting them. Copy source defenses and any known save modifiers. This does not automate unencoded traits or an entire stat block. After success, start the intended encounter with this ID and the admitted party IDs before narrating its result. For spellcasters, copy the listed spells, casting statistics and per-day uses from the source. Zero uses_per_day means at will. Do not infer spell slots or cantrip scaling from Challenge Rating.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: prepare_srd_spell_object
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Classify an admitted object using SRD material AC and suggested average HP. For Huge or Gargantuan objects admit separate Large-or-smaller sections; whole-object collapse, thresholds and other magical adjustments are unsupported.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: prepare_srd_spells
dc533c6bc4229191.description: At an earned rest's completion, apply the player's chosen replacement spells for one saved source. Preserve its cantrip and leveled-spell counts. Source rules enforce replacement limits and Wizard spellbook access; other grants and resource uses remain intact.

spellbook_available.description: For Wizard preparation, confirm the character can access and study their spellbook.

spells.description: Complete replacement list for this source, including its unchanged spells and cantrips.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: prepare_srd_weapon_set
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Prepare actual carried weapons. This costs one Action during combat and is free outside combat. Off-hand attacks remain explicit.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: query_srd_information_spell
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Consume an active information spell using calculated scene facts and source-only outputs.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: query_srd_thunderwave_sound
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Query the recorded Thunderwave boom's fixed range and current Silence.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: read_campaign_reference
dc533c6bc4229191.description: READ-ONLY: retrieve current Campaign State or one additional available Plan, Setting, Ruleset, or Character File. A participant reference returns that admitted character's authored summary and structured baseline when available. This tool cannot update, write, save, or commit Campaign File state. Campaign State is current truth; Plan and Setting material are preparation and defaults. Read for a concrete missing fact that changes present adjudication, or consult Plan preparation when choosing a new situation, assessing objective completion, or closing an episode. Read the smallest relevant item, not to decorate or expand narration. Retrieved detail remains private unless the current action and vantage reveal it. Do not reread Plan or Setting material already projected into the current request. An ID, title or reference path does not include the source contents. For an engine-owned structured input format, read source engine_format, path spatial_scene before constructing a combat scene; it returns the installed schema, example and requirements.

path.description: For campaign_state prefer a stable Campaign File record ID from search_campaign_knowledge. 'current' reads all state and may exceed the byte bound in a mature campaign. For campaign_plan use 'structured' for the whole Plan, 'structured/structure/<act-id>' for one act, 'structured/objectives/<objective-id>' for one objective and its completion conditions, or 'readable'. For a longer readable Plan use 'readable/page/0' and follow the returned next_path; each page is bounded. For participant use its exact participant ID to retrieve that Character File. For campaign_setting or ruleset use an exact admitted package path. Append '#heading-slug' to read one Markdown section without reading the rest of its file. Large UTF-8 files return bounded '#text/<character-offset>' excerpts. Follow next_path or search_campaign_knowledge for a relevant excerpt. For engine_format use spatial_scene (the installed scene schema and example).

dc533c6bc4229191.name: read_srd_carried_item_size
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Read a carried item's size category adjustment from its actual resizing source.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: read_srd_creature_attitude
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Read effective attitude, preserving the underlying relationship during Calm Emotions.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: read_srd_passive_perception
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Calculate actual Passive Perception from the supplied base and active Enthrall penalty.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: read_srd_transformed_appearance
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Read the actual effective form; Truesight distinguishes its preserved original identity.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: read_srd_truth_zone_outcomes
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Return only this caster's saved actual truth-zone outcomes, including later successful saves.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_actor_base_size
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Retain base size from this creature's own validated Character File.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_banishment_plane
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record the GM's creature-type plane association using distinct admitted locations.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_body_vessel
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Bind actual prepared Clone vessel material to its scene object and physical interior.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_contingency_world_fact
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record an actual GM narrative occurrence for this caster's armed Contingency. Use native tools for HP, save, attack, damage and condition outcomes; this tag is a world fact.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_control_held_items
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record current held objects and their named attacks from admitted inventory/source facts before resolving control.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_creature_relationship
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record the scene's creature relationship used by hostility and witnessed-ally consequences.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_creature_skill_checks
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record missing NPC skill-check totals from the creature's existing stat-block source. This adds facts without recreating the creature, changing already recorded modifiers, restoring HP or refreshing its Reaction. Use before a skill check when an older prepared NPC lacks that skill. Character checks derive their own modifiers and cannot use this operation.

skill_checks.description: Actual total NPC skill-check modifiers from the selected stat block. For an unlisted skill use its actual ability modifier. Omitted skills remain unknown; never guess them from saving throws.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_cursed_item
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Bind a cursed item's intrinsic curse and attunement to an actual inventory item.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_deceased_body
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record admitted historical death/body/soul facts; an actual recorded death time stays authoritative.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_demiplane_room_knowledge
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record knowledge of the nature and contents of an actual persistent room.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_earth_material
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record actual natural dirt, sand or clay for one existing terrain identity.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_find_path_location
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record fictional named-place knowledge against an actual admitted location anchor.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_find_path_routes
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record actual physical route lengths at this paid source's current place; do not supply a best-route verdict.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_food_and_drink
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Admit actual food, drink, poison and rot once; later classification cannot rewrite them.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_hand_sized_form
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Classify a fictional trinket or image as fitting this actual caster's hand, with its admitted depiction geometry.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_imprisonment_statuette
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record which actual creature a possessed Imprisonment statuette depicts.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_information_world_facts
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record GM-observed physical candidates at this named place and plane; no spell answer is supplied.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_levitate_object_looseness
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record whether the admitted object is physically loose.
