dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_levitate_surface_grip
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record arm/contact reach fiction against an actual suspended body and fixed surface.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_life_event
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Admit one actual life event or empty historical window; preserve its original truth.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_lite_exploration_object
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Admit a new fictional object for Light/Mending or Fire Bolt outside combat, without map coordinates. Use existing record_srd_object_break/material/container tools for its physical facts. Break bounds are relative to the object: x/y centred on zero, z from zero to height. Existing scene or retained objects cannot be replaced. When included in a combat arena, use the same object ID and dimensions; reconciliation preserves its spell consequences.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_lite_steed_disappearance_facts
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Immediately before a Find Steed disappearance, establish its actual current placement/plane, rider height/clear descent and actual landing/cargo drop. This one-shot record is valid only at this native clock tick with these exact rider/item/native-arrival facts. A positive remaining fall uses the real saved fall/Feather Fall Reaction, paid casting and native protection clock. Declare current caster/target range and sight pairs for other Feather Fall casters; self needs no invented pair. This records facts without costs.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_local_weather_forecast
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Admit the GM's fictional local next-24-hour weather forecast at the actual caster location.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_magic_jar_container
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Bind Magic Jar's actual prepared 500 GP material lot to the possessed scene object.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_map_time_of_day
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record this admitted map plane's current day/night fact independently of any spell.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_minor_world_subject
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Admit an actual object's fictional kind, nonliving material and held-open facts once. Outside combat, the exact retained exploration object owns these facts.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_native_wight_body_destruction
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record observed destruction of this exact original corpse, without asserting death.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_object_access
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Admit mundane access facts for actual scenery; this cannot alter a magical lock.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_object_attachment
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record whether this existing object is physically fixed to a surface.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_object_break
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Admit one physical break or tear by its actual bounds; no HP or magic restoration verdict. Outside combat, retained exploration objects use their local physical facts; no map setup or movement is required.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_object_container
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Admit an actual vessel's physical capacity and existing water, once. Outside combat, retained exploration objects use their local physical facts; no map setup or movement is required.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_object_holder
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Admit the actual creature carrying or wearing this scene object outside combat.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_object_material
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Classify actual object material and raw stock; this cannot change a prepared damage profile. Outside combat, retained exploration objects use their local physical facts; no map setup or movement is required.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_object_utility_facts
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Classify an actual object's weight and manufacture once; no AC, HP or outcome verdicts.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_ordinary_flame
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Admit an actual ordinary flame and whether it is exposed to rain, once.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_planar_patron
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record a cosmic patron known to this caster and its actual loyal creatures (GM fiction).

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_reverse_gravity_anchoring
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Admit anchoring/grabbability fiction against actual creature or object scenery.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_rope_length
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Admit this actual rope object's physical length once, in feet.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_scene_hand_occupancy
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record actual hands and grasps for this body without changing equipment or Somatic facts.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_scene_sight_origin
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record a factual anatomical offset within the current creature's admitted body.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_secret_chest_components
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Bind the actual chest and Tiny replica to their existing priced specific material lots.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_severed_body_part
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record a severed body part as an explicit creature fact for later regrowth.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_soul_disposition
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record the actual individual's free and willing soul facts without asserting death or revival.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_spell_material_object
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Link one actual prepared sapphire material lot to its actual carried scene object.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_telekinesis_object_size
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record the actual admitted object's size category once.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_teleport_destination
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record the caster's descriptive familiarity with an actual destination anchor.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_teleport_similar_area
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record a visually or thematically similar place using two actual spatial anchors.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_water_body
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Admit water and standing/flowing fiction on one real clear passable Box geometry.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_water_vehicle
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record actual vehicle identity and size on an existing non-creature scene object.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: record_srd_wind_flame_protection
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record actual mundane wind protection on an already admitted ordinary flame, once.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: release_srd_unresolved_spell_cast
dc533c6bc4229191.description: In combat, close an open casting window that complete_srd_pending_action refused and that no corrected input can complete. The cast fails without resolving: its Action stays used, no spell slot is spent, and a creature's reserved daily or feature use is settled as for a countered spell. Use it only after a refused completion, never to cancel a spell that can still resolve.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: resolve_adjudicated_creature_attack
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Resolve one current non-participant creature attack using GM-adjudicated values from its admitted Campaign Setting stat block. Use the exact target entity ID from authoritative campaign state and copy an allowed damage die expression exactly as listed in the schema.

attack_distance.description: Actual distance to this target in feet.

attack_modifier.description: Signed d20 attack modifier from the admitted creature stat block or GM adaptation.

attack_name.description: Plain attack label from the admitted creature stat block or the GM's stated adaptation.

damage_expression.description: Damage dice only; select one exact enum value and do not include a modifier.

damage_modifier.description: Signed flat damage modifier applied after the damage dice.

long_range.description: Maximum ranged distance; for melee use the same value as normal_range.

normal_range.description: Melee reach or normal ranged distance in feet from the stat block or stated adaptation.

target.description: Exact authoritative entity ID of the living attack target; do not use its display name.

use_multiattack.description: Use a remaining named component of the creature's prepared Multiattack; true on every attack in that routine.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: resolve_combat_attack
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Resolve one SRD weapon attack, spending a new Attack action only when no Extra Attack remains from the traced weapon catalog.

attack_ability.description: Match the selected weapon. A dart uses Dexterity and a quarterstaff uses Strength. Other finesse weapons permit either, ordinary melee or thrown weapons use Strength, and ordinary ranged weapons use Dexterity.

attack_mode.description: Match the selected weapon's legal use. A dart uses thrown, never melee; a quarterstaff uses melee. Use ranged only for a ranged weapon that is not being thrown.

other_wielded_weapons.description: Actual other weapon IDs wielded alongside the selected weapon, not everything carried. Supply every other held weapon; empty means none.

use_stunning_strike.description: Spend one Focus Point on a hit for Monk level 5 Stunning Strike, at most once this combat turn.

weapon.description: Omit for the clear active main-hand weapon. An explicit weapon must belong to the active prepared set. Ask the player to select an unresolved set rather than substitute another carried weapon.

wielding_two_handed.description: Saved equipped weapons determine actual hands; this legacy input cannot override an active prepared set.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: resolve_combat_attack_followup
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Resolve the optional second attack after a primary Light-weapon attack. Use only attack_sequence light_bonus or light_nick with a different Light weapon; the Ruleset checks the remaining Bonus Action, Nick mastery, weapon choice, and all ordinary attack inputs.

attack_ability.description: Match the selected weapon. A dart uses Dexterity and a quarterstaff uses Strength. Other finesse weapons permit either, ordinary melee or thrown weapons use Strength, and ordinary ranged weapons use Dexterity.

attack_mode.description: Match the selected weapon's legal use. A dart uses thrown, never melee; a quarterstaff uses melee. Use ranged only for a ranged weapon that is not being thrown.

other_wielded_weapons.description: Actual other weapon IDs wielded alongside the selected weapon, not everything carried. Supply every other held weapon; empty means none.

use_stunning_strike.description: Spend one Focus Point on a hit for Monk level 5 Stunning Strike, at most once this combat turn.

weapon.description: Omit for the clear active main-hand weapon. An explicit weapon must belong to the active prepared set. Ask the player to select an unresolved set rather than substitute another carried weapon.

wielding_two_handed.description: Saved equipped weapons determine actual hands; this legacy input cannot override an active prepared set.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: resolve_monk_bonus_strike
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Resolve one Monk Bonus Action Unarmed Strike: Martial Arts grants one eligible strike, or Flurry of Blows spends one Focus Point for two strikes (three from Monk level 10). Use flurry_followup for each remaining strike, choosing its target and Damage/Grapple/Shove effect. This never spends the normal Action. Strength is the default; eligible Martial Arts permits Dexterity and its class damage die. An eligible Open Hand Monk may select one additional technique for each Flurry hit; misses do not apply it.

open_hand_effect.description: Warrior of the Open Hand level 3: optionally impose one technique if this Flurry damage attack hits. Push/Topple saves use Wisdom and the engine-owned DC; no additional Focus cost.

open_hand_push_feet.description: Actual selected push distance up to 15 feet, accounting for the physical surroundings.

other_wielded_weapons.description: Actual weapon IDs currently wielded while making the Unarmed Strike, not everything carried. Supply every held weapon; empty means no weapon is wielded. The engine checks ownership and Monk weapon categories.

unarmed_damage_type.description: Choose Force only for a damaging Unarmed Strike with Monk level 6 Empowered Strikes. Grapple and Shove do not deal this damage.

use_stunning_strike.description: Spend one Focus Point on a hit for Monk level 5 Stunning Strike, at most once this combat turn.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: resolve_opportunity_attack
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend a Reaction to make one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike immediately before a visible creature leaves reach.

use_stunning_strike.description: Spend one Focus Point on a hit for Monk level 5 Stunning Strike, at most once this combat turn.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: resolve_srd_condition_saving_throw
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Roll a creature's saved ability modifier against a condition-causing source's DC; active timed defenses apply automatically. The caller still resolves the source's stated consequences.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: resolve_srd_control_activity
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend the actual task action, preserving activity until its completion is adjudicated.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: resolve_srd_control_order
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Perform prescribed movement through the admitted scene and shared movement budget.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: resolve_srd_fall
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Resolve one actual fall after the GM establishes its distance and landing surface. Roll 1d6 Bludgeoning per full 10 feet (maximum 20d6), apply shared defenses and HP consequences, and land Prone unless no damage is taken. Choose at most one Reaction; Slow Fall requires Monk level 4 and reduces damage by five times Monk level. A liquid landing permits a DC 15 Athletics or Acrobatics Reaction check to halve damage. Character modifiers are derived; NPC checks require saved skill totals from prepare_srd_creature or record_srd_creature_skill_checks. This records a fall, not movement or a voluntary action.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: resolve_srd_fear_turn
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend Fear's real Dash and scene movement, deriving source line of sight at the final position.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: resolve_srd_otherworldly_mount_balance
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Resolve the saved DC 10 Dexterity save after mounted Prone or before involuntary motion. Choose a clear off-mount position at the rider's actual height within five feet; a failed save opens the real fall.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: resolve_srd_scene_relation
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Calculate range, direction, sight and plane from admitted actor/target entries.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: resolve_srd_sight
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Resolve sight from declared scene facts and saved native/spell senses. For objects omit subject_state. Use a test only for a meaningful uncertain Perception check or a visual-illusion saving throw; the GM supplies fictional appearance and actual illusion content.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: resolve_srd_summon_breath
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend a summoned creature's saved Breath Weapon action and resolve one shared cone damage roll.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: resolve_unarmed_opportunity_attack
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Resolve the bound Unarmed Opportunity Attack with the shared Damage, Grapple or Shove rules, spending only the Reaction.

other_wielded_weapons.description: Actual weapon IDs currently wielded while making the Unarmed Strike, not everything carried. Supply every held weapon; empty means no weapon is wielded. The engine checks ownership and Monk weapon categories.

unarmed_damage_type.description: Choose Force only for a damaging Unarmed Strike with Monk level 6 Empowered Strikes. Grapple and Shove do not deal this damage.

use_stunning_strike.description: Spend one Focus Point on a hit for Monk level 5 Stunning Strike, at most once this combat turn.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: resolve_unarmed_strike
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Resolve one Unarmed Strike against a creature entity within five feet. Choose Damage, Grapple, or Shove. Uses the character's Strength (or eligible Martial Arts Dexterity) and Proficiency and the target's authoritative size and chosen saving-throw modifier. An ordinary NPC needs no participant artifact. Each strike spends one attack from the Attack action.

other_wielded_weapons.description: Actual weapon IDs currently wielded while making the Unarmed Strike, not everything carried. Supply every held weapon; empty means no weapon is wielded. The engine checks ownership and Monk weapon categories.

unarmed_damage_type.description: Choose Force only for a damaging Unarmed Strike with Monk level 6 Empowered Strikes. Grapple and Shove do not deal this damage.

use_stunning_strike.description: Spend one Focus Point on a hit for Monk level 5 Stunning Strike, at most once this combat turn.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: restore_srd_resource
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Restore a package-owned resource. For class Hit Dice, select hit_die_class for a partial change; restoring the full total restores every class pool.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: search_campaign_knowledge
dc533c6bc4229191.description: READ-ONLY discovery: find a small set of exact Campaign State, Campaign Plan, Setting, Ruleset, or Character File references when you do not already know their IDs or paths. Results identify candidate references and provenance; they are not the facts themselves. Follow a relevant result with an exact read through read_campaign_reference. Campaign State remains current truth. Similar names may identify different records. If results are empty or irrelevant, refine with a known name/subject and source, or read an available index reference; do not infer that a fact does not exist.

query.description: A natural question or a person, place, subject, relationship, current location, rule, or prepared item.

sources.description: Optional authority sources to search. Omit to search every source available to this campaign.

offset.description: Follow next_offset with the same query, sources, and limit to continue a byte-bounded page. Restart at 0 if campaign_revision changes.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: search_srd_action
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend the creature's Action to make a Wisdom check using an official Search skill.

finding_target.description: Actual creature this Wisdom Perception or Survival check attempts to find.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: set_srd_illumination_cover
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Record actual opaque covering of an admitted light-source object; covering does not quench Continual Flame. Outside combat, retained exploration objects use their local physical facts; no map setup or movement is required.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: set_srd_respiration
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Declare a creature's actual respiration medium and choking. The engine derives breath capacity from its saved Constitution or validated Character File, retains native air/water modes, and consumes Water Breathing at later time and turn boundaries.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: set_srd_rest_activity
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Change ordinary rest activity or resume an interrupted Long Rest. Sleep applies Unconscious and ends concentration; light activity is reading, talking, eating or watch. Exertion does not count as rest, interrupts a Short Rest immediately, and interrupts a Long Rest after an accumulated hour. Cancel abandons the rest. Advance actual elapsed time separately for all resting creatures together.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: shake_srd_sleeping_creature
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend an actual action to shake away selected Sleep sources.

target_distance.description: Current target distance in feet when not supplied by saved combat geometry. Supply the established scene distance; self-targeting is distance zero.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: speak_srd_truth_zone
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Speak with an admitted fiction classification; exact failed zones prevent deliberate lies only inside.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: spend_combat_movement
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend a positive distance of normal or Difficult Terrain movement before or after the turn's action. Use this only when the active creature actually moves a declared distance; never use it to end a turn or discard unused movement. Call end_combat_turn for that instead. For a character’s unobstructed jump, choose long_jump or high_jump and declare the actual running start; the engine derives reach and spends each foot once. For long_jump, difficult_terrain means the landing requires its DC 10 Acrobatics check. Obstacle-clearance rulings are separate. For a Monk of level 9 or higher wearing no armor and wielding no Shield, choose vertical_surface or liquid_surface for Acrobatic Movement. This permits traversal only during this movement on the creature's turn; it does not grant flight, hovering, or the ability to remain unsupported after movement ends. The GM establishes the surface and endpoint from the scene. Active mobility spells also permit fly, climb, ceiling, liquid_surface, or spell_jump. Fly grants 60-foot flight and hovering; end_in_air records whether the creature remains aloft. Spider Climb uses current Speed on surfaces and ceilings with free hands. Jump spends 10 feet once per turn to jump up to 30 feet. Water Walk treats liquid as harmless solid ground while heat remains a separate hazard; use its transition action to enter it.

end_in_air.description: For flight, true if the creature remains aloft after this movement; false if it lands.

fear_source_in_sight.description: Actual visible fear source, used for a Difficult Terrain landing check.

running_start.description: For a jump, true only after moving at least 10 feet on foot immediately before this jump. Record that run-up as movement first.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: spend_srd_bonus_action
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend the active creature's one Bonus Action on an option granted by its canonical artifact state.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: spend_srd_reaction
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend a creature's one Reaction on an option granted by its canonical artifact state.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: spend_srd_resource
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend a package-owned resource. For class Hit Dice, select hit_die_class for a partial change; restoring the full total restores every class pool. For Action Surge, call use_srd_action_surge instead: it also grants the action.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: stabilize_character
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Use the Help action to make the official DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check to stabilize a creature at 0 Hit Points.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: stabilize_srd_creature
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Take the Help action to attempt ordinary first aid on a living, unstable creature at 0 HP able to receive physical first aid. Use the helper's actual Wisdom (Medicine) modifier; the native DC 10 check determines stabilization. Stabilization grants no HP and leaves Unconscious until recovery. This operation does not consume a Healer's Kit or simulate a healing spell.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: start_group_combat_encounter
dc533c6bc4229191.description:
Roll Initiative once for every living creature taking part in a group encounter. Supply all player characters, GM-controlled companions, and hostiles that are present when combat starts. The engine owns the resulting order; never omit a present companion merely to fit the two-creature encounter operation.
Coordinate combat requires a saved spatial scene. For the first encounter, supply one scene in combat_scenes using the spatial_scene format 1 content definition: format=1; map with id, revision, bounds.min/max (three coordinates), grid.cell_size/unit='ft'/origin (two coordinates), and layers (id/min_elevation/max_elevation); entities, geometry, zones and terrain arrays. Each combatant needs exactly one active creature body: id, map_id, position (three coordinates), footprint (box.half_extents or circle.radius), height, facing (two coordinates), active, movement, visibility, and metadata with participant_ref equal to its saved actor ID, creature_type, plane and lighting. Choose physical positions and body dimensions from the encounter fiction; do not invent a target-distance substitute. Include known blockers and terrain. Declare metadata.player.label/kind only on bodies and geometry the player knows. 
Coordinate combat uses the saved spatial scene. Supply one combat_scenes entry when admitting a later roster or an actual new arena. Omit it to reuse the scene. For the same map ID, keep the existing bounds, grid and layers: all saved bodies, objects, blockers, zones and terrain remain authoritative; supplied rows with existing IDs do not edit or relocate them. New IDs add genuinely present scene facts. For a new map ID, explicitly place every accompanying saved body/object by its exact ID. Existing dimensions, activity and mechanic metadata are retained; only actual destination position, facing, plane and ambient lighting are admitted. Include active summons, carried/worn objects, and a live Mage Hand with its cargo and caster. Arena replacement is unavailable while an anchored object, wall panel including permanent Stone, retained coordinate area/terrain or anchored light needs its current scene. Those effects are preserved and the operation clearly rejects before initiative; do not remove them or substitute a different map ID to bypass this limit. Exploration does not require map movement.

uncanny_metabolism_users.description: Monk combatants choosing Uncanny Metabolism when Initiative is rolled: regain all Focus and heal Monk level plus the Martial Arts die, once per Long Rest. Leave empty to decline; eligible level-15 Monks then receive Perfect Focus automatically.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: study_srd_action
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend the creature's Action to make an Intelligence check using an official Study skill.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: take_disengage_action
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend the turn's action so the creature's movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks for the rest of this turn.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: take_dodge_action
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend the turn's action to impose attack Disadvantage and gain Dexterity-save Advantage until the start of the creature's next turn.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: take_srd_otherworldly_steed_action
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Take Dash, Disengage or Dodge with the actual Otherworldly Steed's native Action budget. Enter its controlled phase first while the capable caster rides; an independent Steed uses its own active turn.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: take_srd_short_rest_hit_die
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Immediately after a tracked Short Rest completes, spend one Hit Die and apply its healing. Choose further dice after each result, before advancing time or resuming other activity. For mixed class pools, ask which class's die to spend and supply hit_die_class. Omit it for older single-die characters or a single class pool.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: transfer_srd_attack_mark
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Move a genuine earned curse or quarry mark with one later Bonus Action.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: traverse_srd_tree_stride
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Traverse living same-kind trees using Tree Stride's actual range, size, turn limit and movement costs.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: trigger_opportunity_attack
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Bind a visible leave-reach trigger. For characters select an owned melee weapon, ability and actual grip; attack and damage are derived from saved character data. Raw attack fields are used only for an NPC stat-block attack. Select weapon unarmed_strike for a character Unarmed Strike, then use resolve_unarmed_opportunity_attack.

other_wielded_weapons.description: Actual other weapon IDs wielded alongside the selected weapon, not everything carried. Supply every other held weapon; empty means none.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: unbound_d20_test
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Resolve an SRD 5.2.1 D20 Test without a campaign participant. Supply the explicit ability modifier, proficiency bonus, proficiency factor, target number, and situational judgments.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: update_campaign_file
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Use character_updates for Ruleset-declared ordinary inventory/currency bookkeeping. Read the participant campaign reference for current fields, exact schema and revision first; submit complete replacement field values preserving unrelated holdings. Narrative attributes/facts alone never change equipment or money. Send related character changes and transaction facts together; rejection saves neither. Do not narrate success before acceptance or call failure a stale panel. Combat outcomes require their mechanics. When inventory_updates is offered, it is the active fallback for this campaign. Read campaign_state path inventory for its current holdings and revision; establish owner/holder entities in the same call when needed. Use holdings to establish or correct counts and transfers to move existing quantities. Loans, storage and returns preserve ownership; only explicit gifts/sales change it. Never infer currency exchange rates or use the fallback to bypass a Ruleset rejection. Update your durable Campaign File to the complete decided post-action truth in effect when control returns to the player. If Sylvia is holding a player-facing response, review it against that truth before committing. Store every lasting truth the response establishes or changes, including newly introduced people, places, objects, clues, relationships, promises, knowledge, scene state, and Plan Progress together in one call. Record the GM-owned outcome, not a summary of the player's request and not transient atmosphere. Use Ruleset tools for mechanics. The whole update is validated and committed together before the player sees the response. Any player-facing response and this disposition must describe the same post-action truth. Sylvia releases a settled response only after this call succeeds; it must not advance beyond or contradict the admitted durable state. Set state_change to 'unchanged' and omit all state collections only when the response changes no durable Campaign File truth; that records an unchanged decision without creating a database revision. An unchanged assessment asserts that location, scene, time, physical positions, player or NPC decisions, knowledge, relationships, people, places, objects, reveals, and Plan status are all exactly unchanged from the supplied pre-action State. An unsuccessful outcome can still change location, time, knowledge, or scene facts; record those consequences even when the player's goal remains unmet. Restating supplied Campaign State is not a change. Omit unchanged collections; an included collection must contain at least one change.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: use_monk_focus_action
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Use Monk’s Focus as one Bonus Action, preserving the normal Action. Patient Defense grants Disengage, plus Dodge for one Focus. Step of the Wind grants Dash, plus Disengage and doubled jump distance this turn for one Focus. At Monk 10 a paid Patient Defense also rolls temporary HP; paid Step may carry one willing nearby Large-or-smaller creature. Fixed benefits derive from saved class data. Supply actual proximity and willingness; no armor restriction applies to these Focus features.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: use_monk_wholeness_of_body
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Spend one Wholeness of Body use to heal an Open Hand Monk with the earned Martial Arts die plus Wisdom (minimum 1). In combat this spends the Bonus Action; all uses recover only on a Long Rest.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: use_srd_action_surge
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Use a Fighter's Action Surge on their active turn, before or after their ordinary action. Atomically spend one charge and grant one additional action, except Magic. This costs no action, Bonus Action or movement and is limited to once per turn. Follow with the intended action; spending a resource alone does not use this feature.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: use_srd_dragon_breath
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Use the recipient's actual retained Dragon's Breath Magic action.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: use_srd_native_mummy_glare
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Use the printed standalone Glare action on this Mummy's actual commanded turn.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: use_srd_native_wight_life_drain
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Use native Life Drain alone or replace one actual Multiattack weapon use.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: use_srd_second_wind
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Use one Second Wind charge for a living Fighter and restore Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus Fighter level. In combat this atomically spends the active creature's granted Second Wind Bonus Action. The charge is spent even at full Hit Points.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: use_srd_steed_fell_glare
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Use the Fiend Otherworldly Steed's Fell Glare, recharging after its Long Rest. Outside combat, supply current established_target_distance in feet and established_same_plane=true; these are current fictional facts, never birth placement or a cached map position. Combat still qualifies the actual admitted bodies. Fell Glare also requires established_target_visible=true.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: use_srd_steed_fey_step
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Use the Fey Otherworldly Steed's Fey Step, recharging after its Long Rest. Outside combat, supply the current established_destination description, established_distance in feet, established_plane, established_same_plane=true and established_space_unoccupied=true for the full Steed and its genuine saved rider. This records fiction, never coordinates. Explicitly supply established_environment_source_ids=[] when no environmental source currently interacts with this teleport; relevant unresolved source interactions reject. At combat entry explicitly admit these same Steed/rider IDs at their actual current placements.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: use_srd_steed_healing_touch
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Use the Celestial Otherworldly Steed's Healing Touch, recharging after its Long Rest. Outside combat, supply current established_target_distance in feet and established_same_plane=true; these are current fictional facts, never birth placement or a cached map position. Combat still qualifies the actual admitted bodies.

dc533c6bc4229191.name: violate_srd_geas
dc533c6bc4229191.description: Apply Geas's real Psychic damage at most once per source on each lasting-clock day.

3ec2971a723bccb8.name: begin_srd_spell_action
3ec2971a723bccb8.description:
In combat, begin a source-validated casting action before its spell resolves. Outside combat, cast with cast_spell_outside_combat instead.
For Web, Cloud of Daggers, Insect Plague, Stinking Cloud, Fog Cloud, Sleet Storm or Zone of Truth, set known_area=true only when the player knows the committed spell area from observing the cast or another established fact. Omitted or false means hidden on the combat map. This fact does not reveal its caster or any creature, authorize movement, or change spell mechanics. In combat, Flame Strike requires environment_origin as its chosen Cylinder point; saved positions determine recipients, range and cover. In combat, Fear uses the saved body facing or instant_area_direction/apex for its Cone; Sleep chooses environment_origin for its Sphere. Saved positions determine actual recipients, range, plane and clear paths. For Misty Step outside combat, supply exactly one established destination fact record: its named place, actual current_plane and destination plane, horizontal_distance_feet, signed elevation_change_feet (negative means downward), visible and unoccupied. Do not invent these facts; the destination must be on the current plane and within the original 30-foot straight-line range, including either upward or downward elevation. Combat ignores this record and uses travel_destination and the saved scene.
Outside combat, Find Steed and Summon Dragon use established fictional placement. Supply created_actor_placement (a short established location), created_actor_distance in feet, created_actor_space_unoccupied=true and created_actor_clear_path=true. Summon Dragon also requires created_actor_space_visible=true; Find Steed does not. These facts do not create coordinates. The paid creature keeps its exact saved ID and source statistics. At later combat entry, explicitly include its same ID, printed Large box footprint, actual height/position/plane/ambient lighting and source metadata in combat_scenes. Combat movement, mounting and attacks use that admitted body. Exploration Steed abilities and mounting use current fiction as described by their tools. Combat casting still uses the authoritative scene and its actual placement/sight checks.
Outside combat, when this spell heals a caster with an active Otherworldly Steed, first call establish_srd_lite_steed_healing_proximity with that exact caster and Steed, their current established nearest separation in feet, and whether they currently share a plane. This fact authorizes one healing qualification at the current lasting tick; establish it immediately before the healing event. Birth placement is never current proximity. Combat Life Bond always measures the admitted actual bodies. Outside combat, Mage Hand uses current fictional placement, nearest caster separation and actual clear-path/contact facts, including its cargo and shared plane. No combat turn or map is required. A later Magic action advances ordinary time by one round; the hand moves at most 30 feet and vanishes beyond 30 feet from its caster. Outside combat, Thaumaturgy uses current established origin_distance, origin_has_clear_path and minor_same_plane facts for remote wonders, flames and doors/windows, even when an old combat map is saved. Use the exact admitted minor_object_id and existing subject/access/flame facts. Altered Eyes and Booming Voice affect the actual caster. No exploration coordinates are inferred. In combat, known_area=true also displays a qualified pending area while its casting reaction window is open. Set it only when the player knows the actual chosen area, including any relocated origin. The preview does not reveal creatures, determine affected targets, spend a slot, or resolve the spell. Cone and Line displays show their exact XY footprint, clipped at map bounds; height still affects actual recipients.
For the offered spell bodies, Stone/Fire walls, Aura of Life and magical light, set known_spell_effect=true only for this cast's effect or created body whose presence and placement the player knows from a visible cast or an established current fact. It presents that effect, never a hidden caster, target, scouting eye or unrelated source. Omitted/false keeps private effects private. Range extents do not establish recipients, illumination, damage or safe movement.

This fact authorizes one healing qualification at the current lasting tick; establish it immediately before the healing event. Birth placement is never current proximity. Range extents do not establish recipients, illumination, damage or safe movement.

ec61c2846bd3b7a0.name: cast_spell_outside_combat
ec61c2846bd3b7a0.description:
Cast one of the package's executable prepared spells using its admitted spell definition and reusable resolution family.
For Web, Cloud of Daggers, Insect Plague, Stinking Cloud, Fog Cloud, Sleet Storm or Zone of Truth, set known_area=true only when the player knows the committed spell area from observing the cast or another established fact. Omitted or false means hidden on the combat map. This fact does not reveal its caster or any creature, authorize movement, or change spell mechanics. For Misty Step outside combat, supply exactly one established destination fact record: its named place, actual current_plane and destination plane, horizontal_distance_feet, signed elevation_change_feet (negative means downward), visible and unoccupied. Do not invent these facts; the destination must be on the current plane and within the original 30-foot straight-line range, including either upward or downward elevation. Combat ignores this record and uses travel_destination and the saved scene.
Outside combat, Find Steed and Summon Dragon use established fictional placement. Supply created_actor_placement (a short established location), created_actor_distance in feet, created_actor_space_unoccupied=true and created_actor_clear_path=true. Summon Dragon also requires created_actor_space_visible=true; Find Steed does not. These facts do not create coordinates. The paid creature keeps its exact saved ID and source statistics. At later combat entry, explicitly include its same ID, printed Large box footprint, actual height/position/plane/ambient lighting and source metadata in combat_scenes. Combat movement, mounting and attacks use that admitted body. Exploration Steed abilities and mounting use current fiction as described by their tools. Combat casting still uses the authoritative scene and its actual placement/sight checks.
Outside combat, when this spell heals a caster with an active Otherworldly Steed, first call establish_srd_lite_steed_healing_proximity with that exact caster and Steed, their current established nearest separation in feet, and whether they currently share a plane. This fact authorizes one healing qualification at the current lasting tick; establish it immediately before the healing event. Birth placement is never current proximity. Combat Life Bond always measures the admitted actual bodies. Outside combat, Mage Hand uses current fictional placement, nearest caster separation and actual clear-path/contact facts, including its cargo and shared plane. No combat turn or map is required. A later Magic action advances ordinary time by one round; the hand moves at most 30 feet and vanishes beyond 30 feet from its caster. Outside combat, Thaumaturgy uses current established origin_distance, origin_has_clear_path and minor_same_plane facts for remote wonders, flames and doors/windows, even when an old combat map is saved. Use the exact admitted minor_object_id and existing subject/access/flame facts. Altered Eyes and Booming Voice affect the actual caster. No exploration coordinates are inferred.
For the offered spell bodies, Stone/Fire walls, Aura of Life and magical light, set known_spell_effect=true only for this cast's effect or created body whose presence and placement the player knows from a visible cast or an established current fact. It presents that effect, never a hidden caster, target, scouting eye or unrelated source. Omitted/false keeps private effects private. Range extents do not establish recipients, illumination, damage or safe movement.

Relevant skill and tool proficiency together grant Advantage, never a second proficiency bonus. Use only for uncertain outcomes that matter. 5e535148ef613fc0.description: Resolve an SRD 5.2.1 skill check for a campaign character. Choose the participant, skill, target number, circumstantial modifier, sensory requirements, and applicable advantage or disadvantage. Sylvia derives the entity state, ability, and proficiency from authority. Call this only when success or failure is genuinely uncertain and matters to play. Routine description of immediately obvious surroundings needs no check; a general look around is not by itself a Perception check. Use Perception when detecting something concealed or otherwise uncertain would produce a meaningful different outcome. Never substitute this skill check for a weapon attack, spell attack, or other mechanic with its own exposed operation. 5e535148ef613fc0.name: escape_srd_web

path.description: For campaign_state prefer a stable Campaign File record ID from search_campaign_knowledge. 'current' reads all state and may exceed the byte bound in a mature campaign. For campaign_plan use 'structured' for the whole Plan, 'structured/structure/<act-id>' for one act, 'structured/objectives/<objective-id>' for one objective and its completion conditions, or 'readable'. For a longer readable Plan use 'readable/page/0' and follow the returned next_path; each page is bounded. For participant use its exact participant ID to retrieve that Character File. For campaign_setting or ruleset use an exact admitted package path. Append '#heading-slug' to read one Markdown section without reading the rest of its file. Large UTF-8 files return bounded '#text/<character-offset>' excerpts. Follow next_path or search_campaign_knowledge for a relevant excerpt. For engine_format use spatial_scene (the installed scene schema and example).

5e535148ef613fc0.description: READ-ONLY: retrieve current Campaign State or one additional available Plan, Setting, Ruleset, or Character File. A participant reference returns that admitted character's authored summary and structured baseline when available. This tool cannot update, write, save, or commit Campaign File state. Campaign State is current truth; Plan and Setting material are preparation and defaults. Read for a concrete missing fact that changes present adjudication, or consult Plan preparation when choosing a new situation, assessing objective completion, or closing an episode. Read the smallest relevant item, not to decorate or expand narration. Retrieved detail remains private unless the current action and vantage reveal it. Do not reread Plan or Setting material already projected into the current request. An ID, title or reference path does not include the source contents. For an engine-owned structured input format, read source engine_format, path spatial_scene before constructing a combat scene; it returns the installed schema, example and requirements.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: read_srd_carried_item_size

5e535148ef613fc0.name: spend_combat_movement

end_in_air.description: For flight, true if the creature remains aloft after this movement; false if it lands.

fear_source_in_sight.description: Actual visible fear source, used for a Difficult Terrain landing check.

running_start.description: For a jump, true only after moving at least 10 feet on foot immediately before this jump. Record that run-up as movement first.

5e535148ef613fc0.description: Spend a positive distance of normal or Difficult Terrain movement before or after the turn's action. Use this only when the active creature actually moves a declared distance; never use it to end a turn or discard unused movement. Call end_combat_turn for that instead. For a character’s unobstructed jump, choose long_jump or high_jump and declare the actual running start; the engine derives reach and spends each foot once. For long_jump, difficult_terrain means the landing requires its DC 10 Acrobatics check. Obstacle-clearance rulings are separate. For a Monk of level 9 or higher wearing no armor and wielding no Shield, choose vertical_surface or liquid_surface for Acrobatic Movement. This permits traversal only during this movement on the creature's turn; it does not grant flight, hovering, or the ability to remain unsupported after movement ends. The GM establishes the surface and endpoint from the scene. Active mobility spells also permit fly, climb, ceiling, liquid_surface, or spell_jump. Fly grants 60-foot flight and hovering; end_in_air records whether the creature remains aloft. Spider Climb uses current Speed on surfaces and ceilings with free hands. Jump spends 10 feet once per turn to jump up to 30 feet. Water Walk treats liquid as harmless solid ground while heat remains a separate hazard; use its transition action to enter it.

Use the helper's actual Wisdom (Medicine) modifier; the native DC 10 check determines stabilization. Stabilization grants no HP and leaves Unconscious until recovery. This operation does not consume a Healer's Kit or simulate a healing spell.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: start_group_combat_encounter

uncanny_metabolism_users.description: Monk combatants choosing Uncanny Metabolism when Initiative is rolled: regain all Focus and heal Monk level plus the Martial Arts die, once per Long Rest. Leave empty to decline; eligible level-15 Monks then receive Perfect Focus automatically.

5e535148ef613fc0.description:
Roll Initiative once for every living creature taking part in a group encounter. Supply all player characters, GM-controlled companions, and hostiles that are present when combat starts. The engine owns the resulting order; never omit a present companion merely to fit the two-creature encounter operation.
Coordinate combat requires a saved spatial scene. For the first encounter, supply one scene in combat_scenes using the spatial_scene format 1 content definition: format=1; map with id, revision, bounds.min/max (three coordinates), grid.cell_size/unit='ft'/origin (two coordinates), and layers (id/min_elevation/max_elevation); entities, geometry, zones and terrain arrays. Each combatant needs exactly one active creature body: id, map_id, position (three coordinates), footprint (box.half_extents or circle.radius), height, facing (two coordinates), active, movement, visibility, and metadata with participant_ref equal to its saved actor ID, creature_type, plane and lighting. Choose physical positions and body dimensions from the encounter fiction; do not invent a target-distance substitute. Include known blockers and terrain. Declare metadata.player.label/kind only on bodies and geometry the player knows. 
Coordinate combat uses the saved spatial scene. Supply one combat_scenes entry when admitting a later roster or an actual new arena. Omit it to reuse the scene. For the same map ID, keep the existing bounds, grid and layers: all saved bodies, objects, blockers, zones and terrain remain authoritative; supplied rows with existing IDs do not edit or relocate them. New IDs add genuinely present scene facts. For a new map ID, explicitly place every accompanying saved body/object by its exact ID. Existing dimensions, activity and mechanic metadata are retained; only actual destination position, facing, plane and ambient lighting are admitted. Include active summons, carried/worn objects, and a live Mage Hand with its cargo and caster. Arena replacement is unavailable while an anchored object, wall panel including permanent Stone, retained coordinate area/terrain or anchored light needs its current scene. Those effects are preserved and the operation clearly rejects before initiative; do not remove them or substitute a different map ID to bypass this limit. Exploration does not require map movement.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: take_srd_otherworldly_steed_action
5e535148ef613fc0.description: Take Dash, Disengage or Dodge with the actual Otherworldly Steed's native Action budget. Enter its controlled phase first while the capable caster rides; an independent Steed uses its own active turn.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: take_srd_short_rest_hit_die
5e535148ef613fc0.description: Immediately after a tracked Short Rest completes, spend one Hit Die and apply its healing. Choose further dice after each result, before advancing time or resuming other activity. For mixed class pools, ask which class's die to spend and supply hit_die_class. Omit it for older single-die characters or a single class pool.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: transfer_srd_attack_mark
5e535148ef613fc0.description: Move a genuine earned curse or quarry mark with one later Bonus Action.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: traverse_srd_tree_stride
5e535148ef613fc0.description: Traverse living same-kind trees using Tree Stride's actual range, size, turn limit and movement costs.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: trigger_opportunity_attack

other_wielded_weapons.description: Actual other weapon IDs wielded alongside the selected weapon, not everything carried. Supply every other held weapon; empty means none.

5e535148ef613fc0.description: Bind a visible leave-reach trigger. For characters select an owned melee weapon, ability and actual grip; attack and damage are derived from saved character data. Raw attack fields are used only for an NPC stat-block attack. Select weapon unarmed_strike for a character Unarmed Strike, then use resolve_unarmed_opportunity_attack.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: unbound_d20_test
5e535148ef613fc0.description: Resolve an SRD 5.2.1 D20 Test without a campaign participant. Supply the explicit ability modifier, proficiency bonus, proficiency factor, target number, and situational judgments.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: update_campaign_file
5e535148ef613fc0.description: Use character_updates for Ruleset-declared ordinary inventory/currency bookkeeping. Read the participant campaign reference for current fields, exact schema and revision first; submit complete replacement field values preserving unrelated holdings. Narrative attributes/facts alone never change equipment or money. Send related character changes and transaction facts together; rejection saves neither. Do not narrate success before acceptance or call failure a stale panel. Combat outcomes require their mechanics. When inventory_updates is offered, it is the active fallback for this campaign. Read campaign_state path inventory for its current holdings and revision; establish owner/holder entities in the same call when needed. Use holdings to establish or correct counts and transfers to move existing quantities. Loans, storage and returns preserve ownership; only explicit gifts/sales change it. Never infer currency exchange rates or use the fallback to bypass a Ruleset rejection. Update your durable Campaign File to the complete decided post-action truth in effect when control returns to the player. If Sylvia is holding a player-facing response, review it against that truth before committing. Store every lasting truth the response establishes or changes, including newly introduced people, places, objects, clues, relationships, promises, knowledge, scene state, and Plan Progress together in one call. Record the GM-owned outcome, not a summary of the player's request and not transient atmosphere. Use Ruleset tools for mechanics. The whole update is validated and committed together before the player sees the response. Any player-facing response and this disposition must describe the same post-action truth. Sylvia releases a settled response only after this call succeeds; it must not advance beyond or contradict the admitted durable state. Set state_change to 'unchanged' and omit all state collections only when the response changes no durable Campaign File truth; that records an unchanged decision without creating a database revision. An unchanged assessment asserts that location, scene, time, physical positions, player or NPC decisions, knowledge, relationships, people, places, objects, reveals, and Plan status are all exactly unchanged from the supplied pre-action State. An unsuccessful outcome can still change location, time, knowledge, or scene facts; record those consequences even when the player's goal remains unmet. Restating supplied Campaign State is not a change. Omit unchanged collections; an included collection must contain at least one change.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: use_monk_focus_action
5e535148ef613fc0.description: Use Monk’s Focus as one Bonus Action, preserving the normal Action. Patient Defense grants Disengage, plus Dodge for one Focus. Step of the Wind grants Dash, plus Disengage and doubled jump distance this turn for one Focus. At Monk 10 a paid Patient Defense also rolls temporary HP; paid Step may carry one willing nearby Large-or-smaller creature. Fixed benefits derive from saved class data. Supply actual proximity and willingness; no armor restriction applies to these Focus features.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: use_monk_wholeness_of_body
5e535148ef613fc0.description: Spend one Wholeness of Body use to heal an Open Hand Monk with the earned Martial Arts die plus Wisdom (minimum 1). In combat this spends the Bonus Action; all uses recover only on a Long Rest.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: use_srd_action_surge
5e535148ef613fc0.description: Use a Fighter's Action Surge on their active turn, before or after their ordinary action. Atomically spend one charge and grant one additional action, except Magic. This costs no action, Bonus Action or movement and is limited to once per turn. Follow with the intended action; spending a resource alone does not use this feature.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: use_srd_dragon_breath
5e535148ef613fc0.description: Use the recipient's actual retained Dragon's Breath Magic action.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: use_srd_native_mummy_glare
5e535148ef613fc0.description: Use the printed standalone Glare action on this Mummy's actual commanded turn.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: use_srd_native_wight_life_drain
5e535148ef613fc0.description: Use native Life Drain alone or replace one actual Multiattack weapon use.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: use_srd_second_wind
5e535148ef613fc0.description: Use one Second Wind charge for a living Fighter and restore Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus Fighter level. In combat this atomically spends the active creature's granted Second Wind Bonus Action. The charge is spent even at full Hit Points.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: use_srd_steed_fell_glare
5e535148ef613fc0.description: Use the Fiend Otherworldly Steed's Fell Glare, recharging after its Long Rest. Outside combat, supply current established_target_distance in feet and established_same_plane=true; these are current fictional facts, never birth placement or a cached map position. Combat still qualifies the actual admitted bodies. Fell Glare also requires established_target_visible=true.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: use_srd_steed_fey_step
5e535148ef613fc0.description: Use the Fey Otherworldly Steed's Fey Step, recharging after its Long Rest. Outside combat, supply the current established_destination description, established_distance in feet, established_plane, established_same_plane=true and established_space_unoccupied=true for the full Steed and its genuine saved rider. This records fiction, never coordinates. Explicitly supply established_environment_source_ids=[] when no environmental source currently interacts with this teleport; relevant unresolved source interactions reject. At combat entry explicitly admit these same Steed/rider IDs at their actual current placements.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: use_srd_steed_healing_touch
5e535148ef613fc0.description: Use the Celestial Otherworldly Steed's Healing Touch, recharging after its Long Rest. Outside combat, supply current established_target_distance in feet and established_same_plane=true; these are current fictional facts, never birth placement or a cached map position. Combat still qualifies the actual admitted bodies.

5e535148ef613fc0.name: violate_srd_geas
5e535148ef613fc0.description: Apply Geas's real Psychic damage at most once per source on each lasting-clock day.

advancement.allocation: The Player Character and Companions start and remain at level 1. Story success, defeat, combat and optional jobs never award advancement. Grant only the adventure's actually earned money, possessions and narrative rewards. Any lower-level encounter-variant notes are authoring guidance for a separately revised Plan, not permission to override this declaration in play.
advancement.timing: This edition stays at level 1 throughout its authored adventure and optional continuation. It awards no XP or level increases; changing that policy requires an explicitly revised Plan.

facts.text: Tavin Bell signed a pledge involving a borrowed Warden survey plate to cover mentor Corren’s debt. The plate has not returned to the Lodge.
Salvage captain Eda Venn holds the pledge but lost access to the plate when a Warden vault sealed around her survey crew. Ysra requests its recovery and an honest account.
